labels.symptom: The monitor time ruler can't be zoomed, and the transport buttons are small.
Mouse wheel zoom on the viewer jumps about 40% per notch and overshoots.
labels.root_cause: The zoom step per wheel notch is too large and not multiplicatively reversible.

labels.symptom: The top edge of the top video track can't be dragged to resize it, and the bottom edge of the last track is hard to grab.
labels.root_cause: The outer track edges have no resize hit area, or only a thin one.

labels.symptom: Box selection in the timeline only selects clips when the mouse is released, not while dragging.
labels.root_cause: Selection is applied only when the drag ends.

labels.symptom: Toolbar and track header icons are small, and a toggled-on icon looks almost the same as one that is off.
labels.root_cause: The shared toggle widget draws no distinct background in the on state, and the icons are sized too small.

labels.symptom: Pressing and dragging a grouped tool doesn't open its flyout.
Audio meters overlap when the panel is narrow and stay still while scrubbing.
Label colour sets can't be saved, switched, imported or exported.
The mouse wheel can't be used to switch panel tabs.
The export file name field is overwritten while typing, and there's no way to pick an output folder.
labels.root_cause: The field is refilled from state on every frame.

labels.symptom: The Export window has small controls and a flat layout that is hard to read.
There is no eyedropper tool for picking colours.
5.1 audio on a stereo track plays only the left and right channels, so dialogue in the centre channel is lost.
labels.root_cause: The timeline renderer does not downmix 5.1 to stereo and keeps only the first two channels.

labels.symptom: There is no scene detection to find cuts in a video automatically.
On Windows, dragging files from File Explorer into the app does nothing.
The Color Key effect's eyedropper does nothing.
There is no Dynamic Link-style exchange between the video editor and the compositing app.
On Windows the app never opens a window and the log stops right after the startup lines.
On Windows 11 the process starts, shows as Suspended in Task Manager, and no window ever opens.
Scrubbing HEVC video is slow because software decoding is several times slower than ffmpeg.
labels.root_cause: Motion compensation in the software HEVC decoder is unoptimized and takes a large share of decode time.

labels.symptom: On Windows the MSI installer flashes briefly and closes without installing.
Large projects are stored as one monolithic file, so loading, saving and recovering cannot be done per bin or sequence.
labels.root_cause: Project storage is a single file with no modular format.

labels.symptom: A headless export with missing media writes placeholder frames and exits successfully with no warning.
labels.root_cause: The export does not check whether media is missing before it reports success.

labels.symptom: A keyframe set past the clip end is silently moved to the clip end and can overwrite an existing keyframe there.
labels.root_cause: setParam clamps the keyframe time to the clip end without reporting an error.

labels.symptom: Dropping media on an empty timeline does not create a matching sequence.
Exporting with AMD hardware encoding on Linux gets stuck and never finishes.
The window title does not show the current document's name or 'Untitled'.
labels.root_cause: Window title is not updated from the current document path.

labels.symptom: On Linux, playing audio prints ALSA 'underrun occurred' messages over and over.
labels.root_cause: The audio output buffer is not refilled fast enough or is too small for ALSA.

labels.symptom: Images on the canvas cannot be moved or resized with visual handles.
On Windows on ARM with a Qualcomm Adreno GPU the app hangs forever at launch without showing a window.
Animated level meters freeze while playback is paused and only move when the mouse moves.
labels.root_cause: The UI only repaints on input events and doesn't request repaints while the meters are still decaying.

labels.symptom: CinemaDNG camera RAW footage can't be imported.
WMV video files cannot be imported or rendered.
In light mode a secondary button's label is white on a light background and can't be read.
labels.root_cause: The button label color is hardcoded to white instead of using a theme-aware color.

labels.symptom: Screen readers announce most controls as 'unknown' and the tab order is not logical.
labels.root_cause: UI widgets don't expose accessible labels or roles to assistive technology.

labels.symptom: A focused panel's focus ring is partly hidden by the panel's own tab bars, toolbars and buttons, so each panel shows a different broken ring.
labels.root_cause: The focus ring is painted underneath the panel's child components instead of on top of them.

labels.symptom: The app closes unexpectedly while exporting to MP4 and offers session recovery on the next launch.
Video and image clips can't be aligned or centered in the frame without typing Position values by hand.
Clips can't be dragged or transformed directly in the preview viewport.
Chinese text can't be typed with an input method directly on the canvas; it only works in side panel fields.
labels.root_cause: The on-canvas text editing does not handle IME composition events.

labels.symptom: The interface cannot be shown in Russian.
labels.root_cause: No Russian translation catalog is bundled.

labels.symptom: Motion blur on animated transforms starts one frame early and ends one frame late, which causes ghosting.
Kdenlive project files can't be opened.
Clicking the timeline ruler doesn't move the playhead until the mouse is dragged.
After jumping the playhead with Home/End or to a marker, the timeline view doesn't scroll, so the playhead ends up off screen.
labels.root_cause: The timeline only follows the playhead during playback, so a seek while stopped never changes the scroll position.

labels.symptom: Shift-click in a list adds a single item instead of selecting the range from the anchor.
labels.root_cause: Shift is treated the same as Ctrl/Cmd toggle, and there is no selection anchor.

labels.symptom: Panels can't be reordered by dragging.
Timeline thumbnails flicker during zoom and take a long time to fill in afterwards.
labels.root_cause: Tile timestamps are recomputed from the clip width every frame, which causes cache misses and a decoder backlog.

labels.symptom: Sometimes the window freezes and stops responding when closed, so the process has to be killed.
A clip's position, rotation and scale can't be changed directly in the viewer, only in the properties panel.
The published command schema for applying an audio transition leaves out the edge, params and reverse options.
labels.root_cause: The command's schema string in commands.rs lists fewer parameters than the shared handler actually reads.

labels.symptom: A clip placed at a sub-frame time ends late, and export renders one frame more than inspect reports.
labels.root_cause: Duration is rounded up to whole frames while the start time is kept, so the sequence ends between frames.

labels.symptom: While editing text on the canvas, double-click doesn't select all the text and Ctrl/Cmd+A selects other objects instead of the text.
labels.root_cause: The global select-all shortcut is handled before the focused text editor gets it.

labels.symptom: Unlinking audio and video on several selected clips at once does nothing.
Dropping a clip above the top timeline track does not create a new track.
Nikon .NEV and RED .R3D raw video files cannot be opened.
labels.root_cause: There is no decoder for these raw video formats.

labels.symptom: Linking or unlinking audio and video tracks does nothing, so video cannot be locked to the audio.
Files cannot be dragged and dropped into the app.
There are no Add Tracks or Delete Tracks dialogs for timeline tracks.
Opening a Canon CR3 raw file fails with an error.
labels.root_cause: CR3 raw format is not supported by the decoder.

labels.symptom: Arabic text shows as white boxes.
labels.root_cause: No Arabic-capable fallback font or RTL shaping.

labels.symptom: Pressing Play or spacebar does not play the timeline.
On Linux Wayland the AppImage window shows the generic Wayland icon instead of the app icon.
labels.root_cause: Window app_id/desktop file icon not set for Wayland.

labels.symptom: Making a crossfade means going through menus instead of just overlapping clips on the timeline.
The interface can't be translated without recompiling because all UI strings are hardcoded.
labels.root_cause: There is no runtime i18n system that loads translation files.

labels.symptom: Keyframes on clip scale don't respond when the playhead moves along the timeline.
Opening a folder of about 100 videos in the media browser thrashes the disk and times out.
Long renders can't be sent to other machines on the LAN.
The local automation control server runs commands from any local process or web page without authentication.
labels.root_cause: The control server accepts JSON commands on loopback with no token and keeps reading after lines that fail to parse.

labels.symptom: Timeline edit tools affect every track, ripple delete doesn't shift clips, and shortcuts using Shift, Alt or Ctrl can't be bound.
Paragraph text layers differ from the reference app in baseline placement, alignment controls and text options.
Some dropdown menus can't be closed with Esc or by clicking outside them.
Media cannot be relinked by identity across drives, so projects rely only on each file's last path.
Choosing Sequence Settings from the menu does nothing and no dialog opens.
The issue has no content.
There is no caption support for video projects.
A project with an imported DaVinci Resolve timeline saves without errors but reopens completely blank.
Copying a graphic/title clip on the timeline works, but pasting it does nothing.
H.264 export in the browser sometimes cuts the AAC audio short while the video stays complete.
In the browser, previewing timeline audio sounds bitcrushed or loud and broken, audio scrubbing doesn't work, and panels can't be dragged.
Panels cannot be dragged from one docking area to another.
Camera log and RAW video files (Cinema RAW Light, XF-AVC S C-Log 2, S-Log 3) fail to load or show a black screen.
Chinese characters in file names show up as square boxes.
labels.root_cause: No CJK fallback font is loaded into the UI fonts.

labels.symptom: There is no rolling edit tool for trimming two neighbouring clips at once.
You cannot drag the edge of a transition to make it longer or shorter.
On macOS, media playback is very laggy and the audio is choppy and distorted.
Several editing features from the original app are missing or behave differently, such as movable panels and scroll-to-zoom.
On Linux, audio playback floods the log with ALSA poll() POLLERR stream errors.
labels.root_cause: The cpal ALSA backend reports POLLERR from alsa::poll() on the output stream.

labels.symptom: Exported video has popping artifacts that were not in the timeline preview.
Shared crates such as the codecs are not published separately on crates.io.
Users want optional built-in transcription through a hosted provider (Groq) that feeds word-level transcripts.
A user asks why the project re-implements video decoding instead of using ffmpeg.
Users want support for the OpenTimelineIO format.
Vietnamese diacritics can't be typed through the input method, and the Delete key doesn't delete anything.
You can't marquee-select or delete clips with the mouse and Delete key, and edited clips play back with loud, muffled audio.
On macOS, imported videos show black on the timeline with audio only, and MTS files fail to import.
HDR output isn't supported on Linux.
On Linux, GNOME says the window is not responding while a file dialog is open.
labels.root_cause: The blocking rfd::FileDialog runs on the UI thread, so the event loop can't answer compositor pings.

labels.symptom: Choosing to recover an unsaved project after reopening the app makes the whole computer reboot.
On Windows 10, the portable GUI executable shows a brief busy cursor and then exits with no window and no error message.
Dragging an end of the timeline zoom slider moves only that handle instead of zooming around the playhead.
Piping the command-line tool's output into head or grep makes it panic with a broken pipe error.
labels.root_cause: The CLI writes with println! and does not handle BrokenPipe on stdout.

labels.symptom: Clicking the sequence settings menu item opens no window, so resolution and aspect ratio cannot be changed.
Blackmagic RAW (BRAW) footage cannot be decoded.
Warp stabilization is very slow and cannot stabilize based on a selected area or mask.
Changing clip speed has little or no effect, and keyframes cannot be set up to interpolate between a start and an end value.
Preview and export barely use the GPU while CPU usage spikes.
labels.root_cause: Decode, effects, export rendering and encoding all run on the CPU in software.

labels.symptom: In new projects, step forward one frame sometimes moves backward and step back sometimes does nothing.
The program monitor cannot be toggled to full screen to view the video.
Importing a very large MKV file freezes the app and uses up most of the system memory.
On Windows 10 the installer flashes briefly and the installed app never launches or shows anything.
There is no source monitor for playing back clips before editing.
Imported VP9 WebM videos with an alpha channel show black where they should be transparent.
In the source monitor, Play does nothing, step-forward does nothing, and Insert ignores the In/Out points.
The timeline view cannot be zoomed by dragging the ends of the zoom/scroll bar.
On Intel integrated graphics the window flickers in and out when it has focus or the cursor hovers over it.
The Discord community link is shown in a prominent spot and makes the app look unprofessional.
Users want to load third-party plugins from the commercial app they are replacing.
Video and audio editors cannot share a sample-accurate timeline or play out over ST 2110.
labels.root_cause: Each app uses its own audio device callback as the master clock.

labels.symptom: Source preview playback does not play, Delete does not remove selected timeline clips, and trimming clips is unintuitive.
After updating, the app crashes immediately on launch on older macOS (12.x).
The user asks for better color grading tools and an optional node-based grading workflow.
Audio drops out at random during playback when video clips overlap on the timeline.
ProRes RAW footage can't be decoded.
Misspelled automation parameters are silently ignored and defaults are used.
labels.root_cause: Engine command params are free-form and unknown keys are not rejected.

labels.symptom: No 50 or 59.94 fps frame rate option.
No real-time collaborative editing through a self-hosted server.
Sequence Settings won't open and a new sequence offers no resolution choice.
Source and Program monitors have no Export Frame button.
The same media file can be imported into a project several times, which makes the project lag.
labels.root_cause: Import doesn't check whether the file is already in the project.

labels.symptom: The installer doesn't offer to put a shortcut on the desktop.
The installer does not offer to add a desktop shortcut.
labels.root_cause: The installer has no optional desktop-shortcut step.

labels.symptom: Exported video has a much lower bitrate than the configured target, and imported audio levels differ from the source.
Snapping does not work when trimming unlinked clips on the timeline, along with other timeline editing issues.
Running the Windows MSI installer fails with error 2503 and then error 2502 after the administrator prompt.
The app does not run at all on Windows 11 x64.
Camera raw video formats like BRAW, R3D and MXF cannot be imported.
Motion graphics compositions cannot be live-linked into the video editor timeline; every change needs a re-render and re-import.
Arabic text does not display correctly.
labels.root_cause: Probably missing right-to-left text shaping or fallback fonts in the UI text stack.

labels.symptom: When a video with several audio tracks is imported, only the first audio track comes in.
labels.root_cause: The importer only reads the first audio track of a container.

labels.symptom: Playback shows visual glitches and audio sounds broken when effects are added to a video.
Chinese, Japanese and Korean text shows as empty boxes or 'NO GLYPH' in the interface and in rendered output.
labels.root_cause: The bundled default font has no CJK glyphs and there is no system font fallback.

labels.symptom: Scrolling the mouse wheel over the timeline scrolls the audio tracks vertically instead of moving the timeline sideways.
Dragging to change a clip's length does not work.
Videos with transparency (WebM, APNG, ProRes 4444) show solid black instead of alpha.
labels.root_cause: Decoder ignores the alpha channel.

labels.symptom: Pressing Delete removes items from a panel that isn't focused instead of the focused one.
labels.root_cause: Keyboard shortcuts are dispatched globally without checking which panel has focus.

labels.symptom: There is no AI-assisted object mask that automatically detects and tracks objects.
Audio playback stutters and freezes for seconds.
The media bin panel can't delete bins, can't multi-select assets, and flattens folder structure on import.
In the Effect Controls panel, keyframes cannot be marquee-selected or selected with modifier keys, headers cannot be resized, and selecting one keyframe looks like it selects them all.
On Windows, after installation the app starts and then disappears after a few seconds without showing a window.
4K and log footage cannot be previewed.
Importing a video with two audio tracks shows only one audio track.
WebM video plays as a black picture with only audio, and exports come out black too.
On GNOME Wayland the window title bar is a plain fallback bar that ignores the desktop theme, dark mode and button layout.
labels.root_cause: eframe with default-features=false drops winit's wayland-csd-adwaita feature, so sctk-adwaita is not built.

labels.symptom: Announcement of an Android port with an APK (the body is empty).
The app crashes when an imported .mov video is placed on the timeline.
The interface isn't available in Chinese.
The keyframe curve editor shows curves for scale but not for position.
Lower-end PCs need lightweight still-image proxies to edit high-resolution footage.
Bins in the project panel can't be deleted or nested afterwards, and Select All also selects media inside closed bins.
On Linux, panels can't be moved outside the main window onto other monitors.
labels.root_cause: Panels are drawn inside the single main window instead of as separate OS windows.

labels.symptom: On macOS 12 Monterey the app crashes at launch with a missing system framework symbol.
labels.root_cause: The binary hard-links a VideoToolbox symbol that only exists on macOS 13+, even though it claims to support older macOS.

labels.symptom: The app has no System theme option, so it does not follow the macOS light/dark appearance.
labels.root_cause: Theme comes only from the saved manual setting; nothing reads the OS appearance.

labels.symptom: There is no optional Nvidia CUDA/NVENC path for faster effects and exports.
On Windows with an AMD GPU the app crashes at startup inside the AMD OpenGL driver (atio6axx.dll).
labels.root_cause: GPU setup at startup loads the AMD OpenGL driver, and the driver crashes with an access violation.

labels.symptom: The app cannot be installed on older macOS versions such as Catalina 10.15.
labels.root_cause: The macOS minimum deployment target is set above 10.15.

labels.symptom: Panels cannot be moved or docked to change the window layout.
Stereo 3D markers on video clips are ignored on import and export, so stereo clips are handled as 2D.
labels.root_cause: Stereo metadata is parsed but never used, and is not written on export.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Korean.
Time remapping / speed ramping on a clip does not work.
On Windows laptops with Intel UHD Graphics the app crashes on startup before its window appears.
labels.root_cause: The Intel Vulkan driver (igvk64.dll) crashes when the Vulkan backend is initialized.

labels.symptom: While files are dragged in from the OS, the app does not know where the cursor is, so drops cannot land at the pointer position.
labels.root_cause: winit sends no cursor events during an OS file drag on Windows, so the app has no drop position.

labels.symptom: The app uses almost 100% CPU while idle with an empty project.
After updating, the app lags constantly on older hardware, as if running at about 10 fps.
On Windows, antivirus software flags the portable executable as a trojan and quarantines it.
labels.root_cause: Probably a heuristic false positive on an unsigned executable; not confirmed in the report.

labels.symptom: Transitions on clips can't be selected, deleted, resized by dragging, or edited, and audio crossfades can't be made by dragging a clip edge.
Freeform view doesn't show bins, and the middle mouse button doesn't pan the canvas.
labels.root_cause: freeform_items skips bins.

labels.symptom: Pressing Escape doesn't cancel a drag that is in progress.
labels.root_cause: Drag-and-drop handlers don't check for Escape.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app starts the first time after install but won't launch again after it is closed.
Clicking Sequence Settings in the menu does nothing.
AVI video files cannot be imported.
labels.root_cause: There is no native AVI demuxer.

labels.symptom: Importing an MKV file with several audio tracks creates only one audio track.
On Linux, playback is silent even though the audio meters move.
MP4 files with FLAC audio import with no sound.
labels.root_cause: The native decoders do not support FLAC in MP4, and system FFmpeg libraries are not used.

labels.symptom: On Linux, audio plays fine on some sound cards but is broken on others such as the Asus Xonar DX.
Dev builds fill the disk with tens of GB of debug test binaries and incremental build data.
labels.root_cause: The workspace dev profile leaves the default full DWARF debuginfo on, so every test binary that statically links the UI stack is close to 1 GB.

labels.symptom: On Linux Mint with an NVIDIA GPU, clip playback keeps starting and stopping every second.
Effects cannot be applied to a whole track.
H.264 10-bit or 4:2:2 camera clips import but show black frames with no error while audio plays.
labels.root_cause: The H.264 decoder only supports 8-bit 4:2:0 and the render pipeline silently drops frames that fail to decode.

labels.symptom: Color correction slider and wheel changes only show in the viewer after releasing the control.
On macOS the window's traffic-light controls are out of line with the title bar.
Position, scale, rotation and anchor point can only be edited through numeric fields, not with on-screen handles in the program monitor.
The Effect Controls keyframe area cannot be zoomed, so keyframe timing is hard to adjust.
labels.root_cause: The keyframe view always spans the whole clip.

labels.symptom: The Effect Controls keyframe area always shows the whole clip and cannot be zoomed.
labels.root_cause: The zoom scrollbar exists only for the Timeline's own view state.

labels.symptom: A command can be enabled without a selection and then do nothing.
labels.root_cause: Whether a command accepts named targets is decided by substring-matching its parameter docs.

labels.symptom: On older macOS versions the app crashes immediately at startup with a missing VideoToolbox symbol error.
labels.root_cause: The binary hard-links a VideoToolbox symbol (kVTCompressionPropertyKey_ConstantBitRate) that doesn't exist on macOS 12, and the minimum deployment target isn't enforced or the symbol isn't weak-linked.

labels.symptom: Shift+Delete does a normal delete instead of a ripple delete, and deleting only the audio or only the video part of a clip removes both.
Clicking empty space does not reliably clear the selection or end text editing.
labels.root_cause: Clicks that miss a track row or a selected item are ignored and do not clear selection or focus.

labels.symptom: The app crashes after adding a stroke to text.
Request for AI-based object masking.
Audio effects added to a clip show no controls in the effect controls panel.
Copy and paste keyboard shortcuts do nothing for clips in the editor.
On machines with two GPUs the app uses the weaker integrated GPU and runs very slowly.
labels.root_cause: wgpu adapter selection does not prefer the discrete GPU, and there is no option to choose one.

labels.symptom: On Apple silicon, the GPU Extract effect goes beyond the CPU parity tolerance and the test fails.
labels.root_cause: GPU result for Extract with Invert differs numerically from the CPU reference.

labels.symptom: On macOS, double-clicking a project file in Finder says the app cannot open files of this type.
labels.root_cause: Info.plist has no CFBundleDocumentTypes entry and the app reads files only from argv, ignoring macOS open-document events.

labels.symptom: The app installs successfully from the launcher but does not start.
Export from the desktop app stalls partway and leaves an unfinished file, while the command-line export of the same project succeeds.
Playing at 2x speed mutes the audio.
One default keyboard shortcut cannot be cleared in the shortcut editor.
On older macOS versions the app crashes at launch because of a missing system symbol.
labels.root_cause: The binary links VideoToolbox symbols that are missing on macOS 12, so the deployment target or weak linking is wrong.

labels.symptom: Several professional timeline and workspace features are missing.
Corner pin effect has no on-screen drag handles and cannot stretch beyond the source resolution.
Dragging a clip from the file explorer onto an empty timeline imports it but creates no sequence and does not place the clip.
The label menu shows only label names, not their colors.
AAC and AC-3 audio from Matroska files starts a few samples late.
labels.root_cause: The Matroska CodecDelay is rounded to the 1 ms TimestampScale before packet starts are anchored.

labels.symptom: On Windows laptops with Intel Iris Xe graphics the app exits silently at launch without showing a window.
The desktop app has no guided setup that finds the CLI and produces a working MCP configuration for an agent client.
labels.root_cause: No guided setup flow exists in the desktop UI.

labels.symptom: Desktop installs give no documented, reliable way to run the bundled CLI from scripts or agents without relying on PATH.
labels.root_cause: Windows, AppImage and Flatpak packages don't put the CLI on PATH, and macOS ships it as a separate download.

labels.symptom: On headless Linux with NVIDIA GPUs, every video frame is decoded in software and hardware decoding never starts.
labels.root_cause: The hardware decode backend is never selected (backend stays null) in headless mode, even though NVDEC libraries are present.

labels.symptom: In headless export, automatic GPU rendering still composites on the CPU and does not report that it fell back.
labels.root_cause: No off-screen GPU frame renderer is registered or found in headless mode, and the fallback is not reported.

labels.symptom: MP2/MP1 audio at non-standard bit rates, such as mono 384 kbit/s, imports as silence.
labels.root_cause: symphonia rejects MPEG audio layer I/II frames whose bit rate and channel mode combination the spec does not allow.

labels.symptom: The 'Reveal in Finder' item in a file's right-click menu is disabled and can't be chosen.
Number fields reject arithmetic expressions such as 100*2.
labels.root_cause: Number fields only parse plain numbers.

labels.symptom: When the graphics driver crashes or fails while the app starts, the app dies on every launch until a graphics backend is set by hand.
labels.root_cause: wgpu instance and device creation has no fallback to DX12 or a software adapter when the driver crashes or finds no adapter.

labels.symptom: Gaps between clips cannot be selected, moving clips removes the transition between them, and empty bins cannot be deleted.
Importing a video with several audio tracks brings in only one audio track.
OpenEXR stills and image sequences cannot be imported.
The parity tool measures only the menu bar, not the effects and transitions catalog.
No end-to-end tests check that import, edit and export work together.
There is no macro or scripting support for repeating actions.
Sound stops for the rest of playback after an audio glitch or when the output device is unplugged.
labels.root_cause: The cpal error callback marks the stream failed on any error, even a short-lived one, and the stream is never reopened.
bug_markers: Audio output failed: playing without sound

labels.symptom: DPX files with packed 10/12-bit or Y'CbCr data fail to import with an unsupported error.
labels.root_cause: The DPX reader rejects packing 0 and the Y'CbCr descriptors.

labels.symptom: Mask corners can only be rounded with commands because there is no on-screen handle.
AV1 software decoding is slow because the post-filters run on a single thread.
labels.root_cause: postfilter::apply ignores the thread pool and runs deblocking, CDEF and loop restoration one after another on one thread.

labels.symptom: 4K 10-bit 4:2:2 H.264 footage doesn't play back smoothly.
labels.root_cause: The H.264 decoder is fully scalar with no SIMD, and dependencies between frames limit how far it can spread across threads.

labels.symptom: Opening a project file whose extension is in a different case, or passing a relative path at launch, imports it as media or leaves files offline later.
labels.root_cause: Launch arguments are matched with a case-sensitive extension check and relative paths are never made absolute, and canonicalize produces \\?\ verbatim paths on Windows.

labels.symptom: The engine and UI build for iPadOS, and only the native file dialog crate blocks a full device build.
labels.root_cause: The rfd file dialog crate doesn't build for iOS.

labels.symptom: Holding Shift while drawing with the mask pen doesn't limit segments to 45° angles.
Exported GIFs play slightly too fast because every frame gets the same rounded delay.
labels.root_cause: Frame delays are rounded to whole centiseconds with no carry-over, so the rounding error builds up.

labels.symptom: A roll edit moves the video cut but not the cut on the linked audio, so the audio no longer lines up with the picture.
labels.root_cause: The roll edit doesn't move clips in the same link group.

labels.symptom: Clips and markers can be placed at negative times before the sequence start, where they can't be reached and are cut off in exports.
labels.root_cause: Time parameters are not checked for negative values.

labels.symptom: Adding a marker with an unknown colour name succeeds without an error and silently stores Green.
labels.root_cause: Marker colour names outside the label palette fall back to a default colour instead of being rejected.

labels.symptom: In Brazilian Portuguese only the menus are translated, and panels, dialogs and tooltips show English.
labels.root_cause: The pt-BR translation catalog covers only menu strings.

labels.symptom: The interface cannot be switched to Indonesian.
labels.root_cause: There is no Indonesian translation catalog.

labels.symptom: OpenEXR export writes only uncompressed files, which are much larger than needed.
labels.root_cause: The EXR writer has no compression option.

labels.symptom: Video cannot be exported with AV1 encoding.
On older Intel integrated GPUs on Windows the app crashes at launch, but works when WGPU_BACKEND=dx12 is set.
labels.root_cause: The default Vulkan backend crashes inside the Intel Vulkan driver (igvk64.dll) on older GPUs.

labels.symptom: The app inside the macOS release dmg fails strict codesign verification because of Finder information detritus.
labels.root_cause: Empty com.apple.FinderInfo extended attributes on bundle resources are not removed before signing.

labels.symptom: Undoing a mouse-drag value change takes one undo step for every increment instead of one for the whole drag.
labels.root_cause: Each intermediate value change during a drag is recorded as a separate history entry instead of being coalesced.

labels.symptom: Opening a demo or new document after a saved file keeps the old file path, so Save overwrites the previous file.
labels.root_cause: Opening the demo project does not clear the current document's associated file path.

labels.symptom: On startup, crash-recovery snapshots are deleted when their session metadata is missing or unreadable, losing unsaved work.
labels.root_cause: Recovery scan treats sessions with unparseable metadata as stale and removes them, along with their valid snapshots.

labels.symptom: Imported TTML captions ignore the body's begin offset and appear too early.
labels.root_cause: TTML parser does not inherit the begin time from the body/div ancestors into paragraph timing.

labels.symptom: TTML caption import silently drops paragraphs whose timing is inherited or set only by a duration.
labels.root_cause: The TTML parser requires an explicit begin and end on each paragraph.

labels.symptom: Text-to-speech reads ordinals like 120th as "twentieth" and drops the hundreds.
labels.root_cause: Ordinal conversion of exact tens replaces the whole number phrase instead of only its last word.

labels.symptom: Text-to-speech reads fractions with three-digit parts, such as 7/100, using the word "slash".
labels.root_cause: The fraction rule only matches operands of up to two digits.

labels.symptom: Text-to-speech drops leading zeros in percentages and decimals, such as 07%.
labels.root_cause: The percent and decimal paths parse the integer part as a number and do not read it digit by digit.

labels.symptom: Exporting to Final Cut Pro 7 XML drops source-media markers without a warning.
labels.root_cause: The XML exporter does not write master clip markers.

labels.symptom: Exporting to OpenTimelineIO drops or misassigns markers on nested sequences.
labels.root_cause: The OTIO exporter writes clip instance markers in place of the nested sequence's own markers.

labels.symptom: On macOS, Undo and Redo in the native Edit menu can be selected even when there is nothing to undo or redo.
labels.root_cause: The enabled state of native menu items is not synced with undo/redo availability.

labels.symptom: Automatic transcription does not start when a clip is inserted into a sequence.
labels.root_cause: The clip insertion paths never call the recognizer.

labels.symptom: Playing a marked In-to-Out range stops one frame after the Out point.
labels.root_cause: Playback treats Out as exclusive and stops on the frame after it.

labels.symptom: Changing the hard limiter's look-ahead time does not change how it processes audio.
labels.root_cause: Processing uses a fixed 5 ms window instead of the parameter value; an earlier fix was reverted.

labels.symptom: The noise effect shows the same grain on consecutive frames in high-frame-rate sequences.
labels.root_cause: The noise seed is taken from a coarse time value instead of the sequence frame index.

labels.symptom: Median filter Radius values above four have no extra effect at full resolution.
labels.root_cause: The median radius is clamped to four working pixels.

labels.symptom: The export size estimate for an RGB TIFF sequence is too high because it counts an alpha channel that is not written.
labels.root_cause: The TIFF size estimate always assumes four channels.

labels.symptom: Point markers imported from FCPXML turn into one-frame ranges without any warning.
labels.root_cause: The FCPXML importer does not map the one-frame marker form back to a zero-duration point.

labels.symptom: Text-to-speech reads short hyphenated digit groups with a leading zero, such as 01-2, as a range and drops the zero.
labels.root_cause: The hyphenated-group rule ignores a leading zero in the first group.

labels.symptom: Clips on a locked track can still be trimmed, slid, sped up or have their source ranges changed.
labels.root_cause: Trim, slide and speed edit commands do not check whether the track is locked.

labels.symptom: Rate-stretching a linked picture/sound pair next to a following clip gives the two partners different speeds.
labels.root_cause: The neighbour limit is applied to each linked partner separately instead of to the pair as a whole.

labels.symptom: Placing a subclip leaves out its parent's audio.
labels.root_cause: Subclip placement doesn't inherit the parent's stream metadata.

labels.symptom: Undo after a multi-edit trim nudge restores only one clip.
labels.root_cause: Each clip's trim is recorded as its own undo step instead of one grouped command.

labels.symptom: Match Frame replacement on a reversed clip picks the wrong source frame.
labels.root_cause: The source frame alignment ignores reversed playback.

labels.symptom: Automating short clips to a sequence creates a dissolve that starts before the first clip.
labels.root_cause: The transition length isn't clamped to the reduced overlap.

labels.symptom: Moving a clip off a locked track duplicates it with the same clip ID.
labels.root_cause: The move adds the clip to the target track but can't remove it from the locked source track.

labels.symptom: After a clip's speed is changed, its fade-out stays at the old clip end.
labels.root_cause: Non-ripple speed changes don't move the fade-out transition.

labels.symptom: A dialog closes when it rejects invalid input and loses everything the user entered.
labels.root_cause: The dialog is dismissed and its state reset when validation fails.

labels.symptom: Scripted Source marks given an explicit frame, seconds or timecode are set at the playhead instead.
labels.root_cause: The Source mark commands ignore the time parameters and use the playhead.

labels.symptom: Starting the MCP server with an invalid bridge address exits with a general failure code instead of the usage-error code.
labels.root_cause: The MCP startup path maps address-validation errors to exit status 1 instead of 2.

labels.symptom: Eight-channel AAC files report seven or twelve channels.
labels.root_cause: The channel configuration from the AAC extradata is mapped to the wrong channel count.

labels.symptom: Matroska video with reordered frames and no DefaultDuration reports half its real frame rate.
labels.root_cause: The frame rate is inferred from packet timestamps in decode order, not presentation order.

labels.symptom: H.264 or HEVC video tagged BT.2020 in the bitstream decodes as BT.709 colour.
labels.root_cause: Decoded frames drop the bitstream colour primaries when the container has no colour box.

labels.symptom: RF64 WAV files with metadata after the audio open longer than they are, with noise made from the metadata bytes.
labels.root_cause: The RF64 reader treats trailing chunks as part of the audio data.

labels.symptom: When text has a baseline shift, the letters move but the underline stays in the old position.
labels.root_cause: The plain-style layout path ignores baseline shift when it positions underlines.

labels.symptom: Underline has no effect on vertical text.
labels.root_cause: The vertical text layout path never produces underline decorations.

labels.symptom: The settings schema marks the restore-open-sequences preference as not implemented, even though it works.
labels.root_cause: The schema metadata has wired:false for timeline.restoreOpenSequences.

labels.symptom: Video encoding and decoding don't use Intel GPU hardware for H.264, HEVC and AV1.
Deleting media from the project removes its clips from the timeline instead of marking them offline for relinking.
There is no opt-in way to back up, version or share documents on storage the user owns (NAS, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 via rclone).
There is no sidebar chat window for driving the app with external AI coding agents.
Antivirus scanners on VirusTotal flag the Linux AppImage as a trojan (false positive).
labels.root_cause: Heuristic machine-learning antivirus detection of the AppImage packaging; reportedly also seen with another app's release.

labels.symptom: There is no built-in screen capture that saves recordings into the project folder.
On Windows and Linux the window lacks the standard custom title bar and caption buttons, and there is no System Title Bar preference.
labels.root_cause: Window decoration handling not standardized to the shared custom title bar architecture.

labels.symptom: Audio pitch goes up while shuttling even though the maintain-pitch setting is turned on.
Recording a voiceover over an empty part of the timeline makes the playhead jump back to the start of the sequence.
Position keyframes cannot be given easing or non-linear interpolation; there is no right-click option for it.
Playing 10-bit HEVC video on the timeline drops most frames, and afterwards the editor stops answering control requests.
Several keyframes cannot be selected with a drag rectangle, snapping is missing, and selected keyframes are not clearly highlighted.
New projects cannot have their resolution and aspect ratio set at creation, so vertical formats such as shorts aren't easy to start.
Audio cannot be exported as MP3.
Existing Premiere project and preset files cannot be opened or imported.
VP9 footage plays slowly without hardware decoding.
labels.root_cause: The VP9 loop filter runs on a single thread for each frame.

labels.symptom: Performance stats report zero hardware-encode sessions and frames after a hardware-accelerated export on macOS.
labels.root_cause: The VideoToolbox encoder never calls the hardware-encode counter functions.

labels.symptom: Speech-to-text is unavailable in official builds, and external transcription engines cannot be used.
labels.root_cause: The Whisper feature is off by default, and the packaging scripts build without it.

labels.symptom: Removing pauses and filler words from a transcript happens at once, with no review step or settings.
The MCP automation server cannot be confined to a folder, so an agent can read and write files anywhere.
labels.root_cause: The CLI has no read-root or write-root confinement flags for the mcp server.

labels.symptom: iPhone Apple Log ProRes clips are detected as Rec.2020/BT.709 instead of Apple Log.
labels.root_cause: The importer ignores the LogTransferFunction format-description extension.

labels.symptom: The app does not work (no details given).
The program monitor has no direct manipulation tool.
A long clip name in a panel header pushes the slider rows past the panel edge, so the value column is cut off.
labels.root_cause: The panel header label does not truncate, so the row layout grows wider than the panel.

labels.symptom: Importing a .cube LUT with a zero-width or reversed input range succeeds, but applying it produces NaN colors.
labels.root_cause: The .cube parser does not reject non-finite numbers or legacy input ranges whose max is not greater than min.

labels.symptom: Setting a zero frame rate crashes the automation session and every later call fails with "session lock poisoned".
labels.root_cause: A frame rate of zero or less was accepted, causing a divide-by-zero panic that poisoned the session mutex.

labels.symptom: There are no project rules to stop panics and crashes from entering the code.
The encoder tests missed H.264 streams with dropped slices and flagged good multi-slice streams as corrupt.
labels.root_cause: The ffmpeg test oracle used -v error -ec 0, which hides missing slices.

labels.symptom: Importing a .cube LUT with a zero-width or reversed input range succeeds but produces NaN colors.
labels.root_cause: The LUT parser accepted non-finite numbers and input ranges where max is not greater than min.
fixed_markers: LUT_1D_INPUT_RANGE maximum must exceed its minimum

labels.symptom: A long name in a panel header pushes the panel's controls past its right edge.
labels.root_cause: A non-truncated label in a horizontal row widened the egui Ui's max rect, so the scroll area below got wider too.

labels.symptom: Performance stats show zero hardware-encode sessions and frames after hardware exports on macOS.
labels.root_cause: The VideoToolbox encoder never called the hardware-encode counter functions.

labels.symptom: Recording a voice-over past the end of the timeline jumps the playhead to the start, and nothing is recorded.
labels.root_cause: play() returned the playhead to the beginning when it was past the end, and playback stopped at the sequence end, which ended the take.

labels.symptom: HDR or wide-gamut video drops most frames during playback and the editor stops responding.
labels.root_cause: Clips that needed colour management fell back to per-frame CPU conversion and resampling instead of the GPU path.

labels.symptom: Imported MP4 clips come out one frame too long or lose their last frame.
labels.root_cause: The clip's duration came from mdhd and ignored the edit list.

labels.symptom: Monitor time rulers cannot be zoomed, and the transport buttons are small.
Mouse-wheel zoom jumps about 40% per notch and cannot be reversed exactly.
labels.root_cause: The zoom factor grew linearly with wheel travel instead of exponentially.

labels.symptom: The outer edges of the top and bottom timeline tracks cannot be dragged to resize them.
Timeline box selection selects nothing until the mouse is released.
labels.root_cause: The selection was computed only on release.

labels.symptom: Toolbar icons are small, and a toggled-on icon looks almost the same as one that is off.
labels.root_cause: The shared toggle widget had no background for the on state.

labels.symptom: Pressing and dragging a grouped tool button does not open its flyout.
labels.root_cause: The tool button only sensed clicks, not drags.

labels.symptom: Audio meters overlap when the panel is narrow and stay still while scrubbing.
labels.root_cause: The meter layout had a fixed size, and meter levels were dropped unless playback was running.

labels.symptom: Turning the mouse wheel over a panel tab strip does not switch tabs.
labels.root_cause: The dock tab strip did not handle mouse-wheel input.

labels.symptom: Text typed into a file name field is overwritten on the next frame, and there is no way to pick a folder.
labels.root_cause: The text field was refilled from the stored path every frame, and the save-dialog hook took only a file name, not a folder.

labels.symptom: The Export window has small controls and a flat layout that is hard to read.
Label colour sets can't be saved, switched, imported or exported.
A 5.1 audio clip on a stereo track plays only left and right, so dialogue in the centre channel and the surrounds go silent.
labels.root_cause: The timeline mixer took only source channels 0 and 1 and did not apply a BS.775 downmix.

labels.symptom: A ripple trim that shortens a J-cut clip's head is refused as breaking sync.
labels.root_cause: The sync-lock check looked at the stretch before the cut instead of the stretch after it.

labels.symptom: The signed macOS app in the downloaded DMG fails code-signature validation.
labels.root_cause: Extended attributes added at build time and the DMG packaging step break the strict codesign check.

labels.symptom: Scripted Source Mark In, Mark Out and Mark Split commands ignore an explicit frame, seconds or timecode and use the playhead.
labels.root_cause: Source mark commands always used the Source playhead position.

labels.symptom: Underline has no effect on vertical text.
labels.root_cause: The vertical layout path wrote no underline rectangles.

labels.symptom: An underline stays at the original position when the text baseline is shifted.
labels.root_cause: Plain layout drew the underline at the unshifted baseline.

labels.symptom: The Median effect's radius stops increasing above four pixels at full resolution.
labels.root_cause: The radius was capped at four working pixels and not scaled with px_scale.

labels.symptom: The Extract effect with zero softness gives grey edge pixels and CPU and GPU renders don't match.
labels.root_cause: Zero softness used a tiny artificial fade instead of a hard cutoff; the font picker also registered clipped rows' full rectangles as automation targets.

labels.symptom: Scene Edit Detection is missing from the timeline clip's right-click menu.
APV video files cannot be imported or exported.
Clearing media from the project removes its clips from the timeline instead of marking them offline.
labels.root_cause: The Clear command deleted media that sequences still used instead of marking it offline.

labels.symptom: CI workflows are duplicated in every repo and raise Node 20 deprecation warnings.
Pressing Escape during a drag does not cancel it.
labels.root_cause: Drag handlers did not check for Escape to cancel and restore the original state.

labels.symptom: HEVC video decodes slowly, so scrubbing long-GOP clips is sluggish.
labels.root_cause: Motion compensation used 32-bit clipped stores, per-line memmove calls and redundant copies, and deblocking did repeated divisions.

labels.symptom: Avid Media Composer bins and OP-Atom media cannot be imported or relinked.
On Linux with an AMD GPU, export hangs forever when hardware encoding is used.
labels.root_cause: The GPU readback waited indefinitely, which never returns on a wedged device, and only NVENC was registered for hardware encoding.

labels.symptom: VP8 WebM videos play audio but show a black picture, in the monitors and in exports.
labels.root_cause: There was no VP8 video decoder.

labels.symptom: HEVC decoding is slower per frame than ffmpeg.
labels.root_cause: 8-bit pictures were stored in a wider type and motion compensation copied reference windows.

labels.symptom: CinemaDNG / DNG camera RAW files cannot be imported.
labels.root_cause: No DNG decoder existed.

labels.symptom: Some Simplified Chinese labels are mistranslated or incomplete.
labels.root_cause: There are errors in the zh-cn catalog.

labels.symptom: There is no way to star favorite themes and switch between them quickly.
The localization docs list German as unsupported even though menus are translated.
HEVC playback does not scale well on machines with many cores.
labels.root_cause: Each HEVC picture was decoded on a single thread.

labels.symptom: DNG footage can't be adjusted with raw settings, lossy DNGs are refused, opcode lists are ignored and decoding is too slow for smooth 4K playback.
CinemaDNG footage wrapped in MXF does not open, and raw clips have no per-clip development settings.
A button's label can't be seen in light mode because it is white text on a near-white background.
labels.root_cause: The text colour was hard-coded to white instead of taken from the theme.

labels.symptom: Stereo clips imported from FCP7 XML play louder because both halves come out of both speakers.
labels.root_cause: Mono halves of a split stereo clip were imported centred instead of panned to their own side.

labels.symptom: The interface isn't available in Turkish, Italian or Vietnamese.
Transparent ProRes 4444 overlays show as opaque in the preview but export correctly.
labels.root_cause: The GPU compositor never uploaded the alpha plane of Y'CbCr frames, and the shader returned alpha 1.0.

labels.symptom: Shift-click in the project panel toggles one item instead of selecting the range from the anchor.
labels.root_cause: The panel kept no selection anchor, so Shift-click was handled the same as Ctrl/Cmd-click.

labels.symptom: After Home, End or other playhead jumps while stopped, the timeline does not scroll to show the playhead.
labels.root_cause: The timeline followed the playhead only during playback.

labels.symptom: Placing a subclip on the timeline adds only video and drops the parent clip's audio.
labels.root_cause: Placement didn't look at the parent media's audio streams.

labels.symptom: The VP9 decoder can panic on malformed streams or when a thread fails to spawn.
labels.root_cause: unwrap, expect and panic calls in the decoder.

labels.symptom: Text-to-speech drops the leading zero of hyphenated numbers like 01-2 and reads them as a range.
labels.root_cause: Number normalization only checked later digit groups for leading zeros, not the first.

labels.symptom: On macOS, Cmd+A while editing text selects every object in the document instead of the text being edited.
labels.root_cause: The native menu bar takes Cmd+A as its Select All shortcut before the in-app text editor sees the key.

labels.symptom: An automation command's schema leaves out parameters that the command actually accepts.
labels.root_cause: The audio transition schema was not updated to match the shared handler.

labels.symptom: Continuous timeline thumbnails flicker and take 20 seconds or more to come back after zooming.
labels.root_cause: Each zoom step requested new thumbnail frames, which missed the cache and filled the decode queue with jobs that were no longer needed.

labels.symptom: Pressing on the timeline ruler does not move the playhead until the mouse moves or the button is released.
labels.root_cause: The playhead was only set on drag start or click, not when the button went down.

labels.symptom: Chinese, Japanese or Korean text typed with an input method does not appear in a custom text editor on the canvas, while English typing works.
labels.root_cause: The custom text editing code handled typed and pasted text but dropped the IME commit event.

labels.symptom: Unknown or misspelt export settings keys are silently ignored, so the export runs with the wrong settings.
labels.root_cause: The settings were deserialized with serde(default), which drops unknown keys.

labels.symptom: On a Wayland session, dragging a file from the file manager onto the window shows a 'no' cursor and does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The Wayland backend of winit 0.30 has no drag-and-drop support.

labels.symptom: The timeline's nest toggle button is always on and does nothing.
Nested sequences ignore speed, effects and sample-rate differences, and come in at the wrong size.
labels.root_cause: Nested audio skipped the media-clip path, so it was never resampled or processed.

labels.symptom: Timeline tabs share one zoom and scroll, and open panel menus stay open after clicking elsewhere.
Nested sequences export and import as gaps in AAF, and EDL uses the wrong reel name for them.
Add Tracks only adds one video track, with no way to add audio tracks.
labels.root_cause: The command added a single video track and had no dialog.

labels.symptom: Media info shows a missing or wrong pixel format and alpha for HEVC, H.264 4:2:2 and ProRes 4444 files.
labels.root_cause: The pixel format was guessed from the codec profile instead of read from hvcC, avcC or the ProRes frame header.

labels.symptom: A corrupt H.264 stream can crash a decoder worker.
labels.root_cause: Integer overflow in chroma DC dequantisation, plus unwrap calls in the decoder.

labels.symptom: In the timeline, mouse-wheel scrolling goes the wrong way, Cmd+wheel zooms, and you can scroll past the end of the sequence.
labels.root_cause: egui turns Cmd+wheel into zoom, and the scroll range was never limited, so the scroll bar's range grew with the position.

labels.symptom: You can't save your own custom workspaces.
The README has no star history chart.
While the control port is open, any web page in the browser can drive the app by sending an HTTP request to localhost.
labels.root_cause: The control server kept reading after a non-JSON line, so it ran the JSON body of an HTTP POST as a command.

labels.symptom: A ripple trim that shortens a clip's head after an L cut is refused as breaking sync.
labels.root_cause: The previous clip's linked sound running past the cut was counted as in the way.

labels.symptom: Package managers and app stores show a sibling app's description, categories, file types and a broken screenshot link.
labels.root_cause: Packaging metadata was copied from a sibling app's template and never updated.

labels.symptom: The menus can now be shown in Spanish as well as English and Japanese.
Line icons look blurry and unevenly spaced at 1x scaling.
labels.root_cause: Icon strokes were drawn at fractional pixel positions and widths.

labels.symptom: HE-AAC audio plays at half speed or at the wrong rate, and AAC export doesn't cap the bitrate.
labels.root_cause: The MP4 reader reported the AAC core rate instead of the SBR output rate.

labels.symptom: The HEVC decoder can panic on malformed streams.
labels.root_cause: unwrap and expect calls in the decoder.

labels.symptom: Interface fonts and menus don't match the look of the original app.
Audio playback crackles and drops out at random spots on a busy Mac.
labels.root_cause: Decoding and mixing ran inside the real-time audio output callback with no buffer ahead, so any stall missed the device's deadline.

labels.symptom: Audio buzzes or aliases when the output device's sample rate differs from the project's.
labels.root_cause: Each device buffer was resampled on its own with a truncated start and nearest-sample picking, so phase was lost at every block boundary.

labels.symptom: The AV1 decoder can panic on unexpected internal states.
labels.root_cause: expect calls in the decoder.

labels.symptom: H.264 and HEVC video is decoded in software on Windows instead of on the GPU.
Opening a crafted MP4 or project file crashes the app with an arithmetic overflow or stack overflow.
labels.root_cause: MP4 edit-list offset multiplication overflowed i64, and subclip duration recursion had no bound.

labels.symptom: A media test fails now and then because parallel tests read image-sequence fixtures that are still being written.
labels.root_cause: Test fixture frames were written in place into a shared directory with no atomic rename, so concurrent tests raced.

labels.symptom: MCP render tools marked read-only move the playhead and change the selection.
labels.root_cause: Rendering at a time moved the session playhead instead of rendering without changing state.

labels.symptom: Color mattes are always grey and their color cannot be chosen or changed.
labels.root_cause: There was no color dialog, and the media pool used an empty cache key for generators, so it served the wrong cached source.

labels.symptom: In release builds without speech-to-text, transcription commands show as enabled but always fail, and auto-transcribe silently does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The commands had no enabled check tied to the compiled speech features.

labels.symptom: The Linux rpm installs on RHEL 9 family systems, but the programs then fail to start with 'GLIBC_2.35 not found'.
labels.root_cause: The rpm package declared no glibc version requirement, unlike the deb.

labels.symptom: The first second of exported H.264 video looks much softer than the rest.
labels.root_cause: One-pass rate control priced its virtual one-second history once, from the initial guess, which made it far too costly.

labels.symptom: Damaged container files can crash the app on import.
labels.root_cause: Container parsers used expect and unreachable.

labels.symptom: In release builds without speech-to-text, transcription commands show as enabled but always fail, and auto-transcribe silently does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The command predicates were 'always' instead of checking whether the speech features were compiled in.

labels.symptom: A long blocking export over the control channel freezes the app with no progress and reports a timeout even though it succeeds.
labels.root_cause: A blocking export was forwarded to the app, which encoded on the UI thread and ran past the control server's 60 s reply limit.

labels.symptom: On Linux, pressing Play does nothing when the audio device stops responding.
labels.root_cause: The playhead follows the audio device's played-frames clock, which never moves when the device callback never runs.

labels.symptom: Docs and CLI help are outdated: a missing releasing guide, an old sibling name, wrong command counts and missing export options.
labels.root_cause: The docs drifted from the code and sibling repos were renamed.

labels.symptom: In the Flatpak build, files referenced by a document from folders like ~/Videos or ~/Music show up as missing.
labels.root_cause: The Flatpak manifest granted only xdg-pictures access, and the document portal exposes only the opened file.

labels.symptom: In the browser build some scripting API promises reject with plain strings instead of Error objects, so e.message is undefined.
labels.root_cause: Some web API members rejected with raw strings instead of wrapping failures in an Error.

labels.symptom: Some audio and video codecs can crash on unexpected input.
labels.root_cause: Codec crates used panicking calls in production code.

labels.symptom: VP9 and AV1 video is decoded in software on Windows instead of on the GPU.
Browsing a folder of large media files reads each file in full and uses a lot of memory.
labels.root_cause: The fallback for byte-based openers read the whole file just to probe it.

labels.symptom: Text layers have only one kind of resize handle instead of separate point text and paragraph text behaviour.
A file or project with a zero frame rate or timescale, or a huge timecode, crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Time math divided by zero denominators and overflowed on huge timecodes.

labels.symptom: Shortcuts using Shift, Ctrl or Alt cannot be recorded in the keyboard shortcuts dialog, which says the modifier key can't be used as a shortcut.
labels.root_cause: egui reports a modifier key as a key event of its own, and the recorder took that first press instead of waiting for the modified key.
bug_markers: AltLeft can't be used as a shortcut

labels.symptom: In the browser build, picking a file to relink a missing item imports it as a new item instead of linking it.
labels.root_cause: The web file picker is asynchronous and the synchronous pick_files hook returned no path, so the relink command ran without one.

labels.symptom: Clips keep showing 'media not found' after their missing file is imported again.
labels.root_cause: Import did not rebuild the list of missing offline media.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Brazilian Portuguese.
Sibling-app references still use the old name PrintCraft instead of PdfCraft.
Importing a damaged MP4, MOV or TS file crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: An empty sample-description list was indexed, and a zero timescale or zero frame rate caused a division by zero.

labels.symptom: Export cannot use NVIDIA hardware H.264 encoding on Windows.
Graphic layers keep their outline box after being deselected, and hidden layers can still be clicked and dragged.
labels.root_cause: The overlay outlined every layer of the selected clip and never checked whether a layer was visible.

labels.symptom: Video export has no option to use the Mac's hardware H.264 encoder.
Exports with overlay layers spend most of their time compositing full-frame float images.
labels.root_cause: Every layer was converted and blended over the whole frame, including fully transparent areas and a zero-filled canvas.

labels.symptom: Render progress shows only a percentage, with no estimate of the time left.
Video cannot be exported as H.265/HEVC.
Select All does not select imported items in the project/media panel.
labels.root_cause: The select-all command only filled the timeline clip selection, and no command selected the project panel's items.

labels.symptom: Exporting the same project twice can produce different files on different machines.
labels.root_cause: Mux batch size and H.264 slice count depended on the number of CPU cores.

labels.symptom: An imported picture smaller than the frame ends up in the wrong place when its position is set.
labels.root_cause: The anchor point was computed from the sequence frame size instead of the picture's own size.

labels.symptom: Several project, timeline, audio and export workflows are unstable, including recovery after a failed save and export cancellation.
Vertical type cannot be chosen from the Type tool's flyout, and a long press or right-click does not open grouped tool flyouts.
Portrait phone videos import sideways at their landscape size.
labels.root_cause: The container's display rotation matrix and projection were parsed but never applied.

labels.symptom: Importing a damaged interchange or caption file, or exporting a very long clip, can crash the app.
labels.root_cause: The WAVE header size overflowed, and importers used expect and unwrap.

labels.symptom: Ripple delete fails with an unclear sync-lock message, and the playhead sticks while being dragged.
labels.root_cause: The sync-lock error did not name the track, and the playhead snapped to its own position.

labels.symptom: On Windows and Linux, the Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X and Ctrl+V shortcuts do nothing, but Copy, Cut and Paste in the Edit menu work.
labels.root_cause: egui-winit sends Event::Copy, Event::Cut and Event::Paste instead of key presses, and the shortcut handler only matches key presses.

labels.symptom: Ripple trim shortcuts affect all tracks instead of only the selected clip's track.
labels.root_cause: Trim to playhead acted on every targeted track and ignored the selection.

labels.symptom: Audio playback or recording fails on devices that only offer integer sample formats.
labels.root_cause: The CPAL stream setup did not handle audio devices that use integer sample formats.

labels.symptom: Rendering or the CLI can panic on unexpected internal states.
labels.root_cause: expect and unreachable calls in the GPU compositor, the renderer and the CLI.

labels.symptom: Hostile project, export or MXF files could be accepted without validation.
labels.root_cause: Inputs were not validated.

labels.symptom: A copied graphic clip does not paste at the playhead.
Speed/Duration applies 50% at once with no dialog, and undoing a parameter drag only steps back a little at a time.
labels.root_cause: The menu item had a hard-coded speed value, and each frame of a drag was recorded as its own undo step.

labels.symptom: The About window doesn't credit contributors or models.
Exporting to H.264 can crash on a malformed input frame.
labels.root_cause: Encoder::encode called expect on try_encode.

labels.symptom: Go to In / Go to Out does nothing when no marks are set.
labels.root_cause: The commands only moved the playhead when a mark existed.

labels.symptom: In the browser version, background jobs crash with 'time not implemented on this platform'.
labels.root_cause: Job code called std::time::Instant::now(), which panics on wasm32.

labels.symptom: Only the menus are translated, and the chosen interface language is not remembered after a restart.
A command sent with a stale or missing item id crashes the app instead of returning an error.
labels.root_cause: Engine commands used expect on lookups that can fail.

labels.symptom: In the browser version, importing a different file with the same name and size replaces the media of an earlier import.
labels.root_cause: Browser imports reused the virtual path keyed on filename and byte length.

labels.symptom: Imported files land at the project root instead of the project bin that is open.
labels.root_cause: File-dialog and drag-and-drop imports did not pass the open bin as the destination.

labels.symptom: Exported PNG image sequences have a black background instead of transparency.
labels.root_cause: The export pipeline flattened every frame over black, and TIFF encoding always dropped the alpha channel.

labels.symptom: On Linux, development builds show a generic icon in the taskbar and title bar instead of the app icon.
labels.root_cause: Source-tree runs have no installed .desktop entry or hicolor icon matching the window's app id.

labels.symptom: The README has no instructions for installing on Gentoo.
Warnings and errors are never written anywhere, so there is no log to attach to a bug report.
labels.root_cause: The desktop app never installs a logger, so log records are discarded.

labels.symptom: In headless or automation use, a failing command ends the process and loses unsaved work, and background jobs that crash show as running forever.
labels.root_cause: Command execution and background job threads were not wrapped in catch_unwind.

labels.symptom: After Unlink, dragging the video still moves its audio, so Unlink seems to do nothing.
labels.root_cause: Both formerly linked clips stayed selected after unlinking.

labels.symptom: Strict Clippy fails the build on a newer Rust toolchain.
labels.root_cause: New Clippy lints in Rust 1.95 flag nested match-arm conditions and nonminimal boolean expressions.

labels.symptom: Deleting project bins by id through automation fails with 'not available right now' unless something is selected in the Project panel.
labels.root_cause: The explicit-target check accepted only project item ids, not bin ids, so it fell back to the empty selection.

labels.symptom: On Linux, playback is silent when the ALSA default output device can't be opened.
labels.root_cause: cpal opened only the ALSA default PCM and had no fallback to another working output device.

labels.symptom: Sending Ctrl+ key chords through the automation control channel does not trigger shortcuts on Windows or Linux; only Cmd+ works.
labels.root_cause: The synthetic key events mapped Ctrl to ctrl alone without setting the command modifier, which the shortcut bindings require.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking the cut between two clips opens the clip menu instead of an edit point menu with Apply Default Transitions.
labels.root_cause: Right-clicking a clip's edge was treated as a click on the clip body.

labels.symptom: A panel keeps failing every frame when the project refers to an item that no longer exists.
labels.root_cause: UI panels call expect or unreachable on lookups that can fail.

labels.symptom: Pressing Delete with timeline clips selected does not remove them.
labels.root_cause: Delete was bound only to the application-wide project delete command, with no Timeline-panel binding for clear.

labels.symptom: The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window without a branded background or icon layout.
labels.root_cause: The DMG packaging had no background image or Finder layout settings.

labels.symptom: In the browser version, a failed recovery snapshot is not retried, and skip-recovery flags make an unsaved project unrecoverable.
labels.root_cause: Snapshot write failures were not reported, the revision was recorded as saved before the write ran, and a clean session marked the earlier snapshot clean.

labels.symptom: Right-click menus have different entries and order from the reference app and do not share the main menu look.
No FreeBSD or Flatpak release builds are published and AppImages cannot update themselves.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow lacked FreeBSD and Flatpak jobs and AppImages had no embedded zsync update info.

labels.symptom: New Sequence creates a default sequence right away instead of showing a settings dialog.
The app can crash from unwrap or expect panics in production code, including in the web build.
labels.root_cause: Panicking calls were not blocked by clippy lints in production crates.

labels.symptom: On Windows and Linux, status-bar hints and tooltips name the Mac keys Opt and Cmd instead of Alt and Ctrl.
labels.root_cause: The hint strings were hard-coded with Mac modifier names.

labels.symptom: The README Downloads section doesn't say where to get the app first and lists macOS builds before Windows.
With audio scrubbing turned on, scrubbing is still silent.
labels.root_cause: The scrub-audio setting was saved but nothing read it.

labels.symptom: In vertical Japanese text, punctuation such as 、。「」ー shows as horizontal glyphs in the wrong position.
labels.root_cause: Vertical layout did not apply the OpenType vert/vrt2 features or vertical origins.

labels.symptom: There is no way to generate text-to-speech narration clips.
MCP tools have no annotations, and mistyped arguments are silently ignored.
labels.root_cause: Unknown arguments weren't rejected and tools carried no annotations.

labels.symptom: On Windows, output paths starting with ~ are not expanded, and paths with a trailing backslash or a \\?\ prefix are handled wrongly.
labels.root_cause: Home-folder expansion read only HOME, and path handling ignored backslash separators and verbatim (\\?\) paths.

labels.symptom: In vertical text, combining marks such as dakuten or accents appear in a separate cell from their base letter.
labels.root_cause: Vertical cells were split per Unicode scalar instead of per grapheme cluster.

labels.symptom: The command-line tool panics with a broken pipe error when its output is piped to head.
labels.root_cause: println! panics when writing to a closed stdout.

labels.symptom: Clips cannot be generated from ComfyUI workflows.
After an export finishes, the app keeps hundreds of megabytes of idle memory.
labels.root_cause: The process-wide frame buffer pool was never trimmed after an export ended.

labels.symptom: After creating an empty sequence and adding clips, the timeline stays zoomed to one second so clips run off screen.
labels.root_cause: The timeline fit only once on open, using the empty sequence's 1 s minimum duration.

labels.symptom: The app stalls briefly the first time the Export view is opened.
labels.root_cause: The hardware HEVC availability probe created an encoder session on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: The Windows portable version writes preferences, logs and recovery files to %APPDATA% instead of next to the executable.
labels.root_cause: The data directory always used the platform default with no portable marker check.

labels.symptom: Dragging a property value does not update the preview until the mouse stops.
labels.root_cause: Stand-in frame lookup ignored earlier revisions and slow in-flight frames were cancelled.

labels.symptom: Loudness analysis measures mono clips about 3 LU too loud.
labels.root_cause: Mono sources were metered as dual-mono stereo pairs.

labels.symptom: Clicking the keyframe diamond removes all keyframes, and there is no keyframe navigator or time ruler.
labels.root_cause: The diamond ran the toggle-animation command instead of add/remove keyframe.

labels.symptom: Push transitions drop many frames during playback because they render on the CPU.
labels.root_cause: Push transitions were not supported by the GPU compositor and fell back to CPU rendering.

labels.symptom: Version bump to 0.2.0.
YUV video frames are converted with slightly wrong levels and colours.
labels.root_cause: Range normalization used the texture decoding scale as the quantization code count.

labels.symptom: Clips with a blend mode force the whole frame through the slow CPU renderer, which drops frames during playback.
labels.root_cause: The GPU compositor did not support blend modes other than Normal.

labels.symptom: Frame stepping moves backward, stalls or skips at non-standard frame rates.
labels.root_cause: Floor division in tick_of truncated non-integer frame durations, breaking the frame/tick round-trip.

labels.symptom: H.265 (HEVC) export is not available on Windows machines with NVIDIA GPUs.
H.264/HEVC video decodes only in software on macOS.
Panels cannot be dragged to new spots in the workspace or undocked as floating windows.
On Linux systems using PipeWire, playback is silent and the log fills with ALSA underrun errors.
labels.root_cause: cpal's ALSA output through the pipewire-alsa bridge fails after its first callback and never recovers.

labels.symptom: On Windows, moving or relinking a project fails because paths don't match.
labels.root_cause: Native backslash paths were compared with slash-separated strings.

labels.symptom: Source media cannot be played with sound or dragged to the timeline as a marked range.
The roadmap overstates how close the app is to parity with the commercial original.
Apps that embed the UI cannot wake it for repaints or hide the header and status bar.
Clips with common standard effects are rendered on the CPU, which slows playback.
Licensed codecs cannot be left out of a build.
The camera buttons on the Source and Program monitors do nothing instead of exporting a frame.
The Sequence Settings menu item does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The menu ran the command with no parameters instead of opening a dialog.

labels.symptom: Running the command-line tool with --help prints 'missing subcommand' and exits with code 2 instead of showing usage.
labels.root_cause: The leading --help flag was parsed as a flag, so no positional subcommand was left.

labels.symptom: On Linux, H.264 and HEVC video is decoded only in software.
Audio from MKV or OBS-remuxed MP4 files crackles during playback and after export.
labels.root_cause: Each decoded AAC packet was placed at its millisecond-rounded timestamp, which caused overlaps and gaps of silence.

labels.symptom: Agent instructions do not point to the shared real-file test corpora.
HDR sequences cannot be exported as 10-bit HEVC with hardware encoding.
Only the first audio stream is imported from videos that contain several audio streams.
labels.root_cause: Media probing kept only the first audio stream it found in the container.

labels.symptom: The CLI export message names the requested path instead of the file actually written.
labels.root_cause: The stderr message used the argument path instead of the path in the export result.

labels.symptom: Chinese text such as file names and labels shows as missing-glyph boxes when the interface language is English.
labels.root_cause: The UI font families had no Chinese fallback faces installed.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app exits right after launch and no window appears.
labels.root_cause: eframe's default wgpu instance enables the OpenGL backend, and creating it can crash inside AMD's OpenGL driver (atio6axx.dll).

labels.symptom: Loading a compatibility keyboard shortcut preset on Linux maps a shortcut to the wrong action because of duplicate key chords.
labels.root_cause: Generated built-in presets kept duplicate physical chords within a panel context, so an inherited binding won over the preset's own binding.

labels.symptom: Cancelling a movie export deletes numbered files with similar names in the same folder.
labels.root_cause: The cleanup step treated every <stem><digits> file as a frame of an image sequence, even for single-file exports.

labels.symptom: The app is not built or tested on FreeBSD, and shortcuts and the GPU effect fallback misbehave there.
labels.root_cause: There was no FreeBSD CI job, and there were platform assumptions in the shortcut and GPU adapter code.

labels.symptom: Video export is slower and uses more peak memory than needed, with no per-stage timing.
Giving a duration when creating a text or shape clip also shifts where the clip starts on the timeline.
labels.root_cause: The shared time parser read the 'seconds' duration as a placement time and gave it priority over 'timecode'.

labels.symptom: The audio gain command reports gains for linked video clips that did not change, and reports gains before they are clamped.
labels.root_cause: The response was built from the expanded linked targets instead of the audio items actually edited, after clamping.

labels.symptom: In the browser, every decoded video frame goes through a slow canvas RGBA conversion.
labels.root_cause: WebCodecs frames were converted through Canvas RGBA instead of passing YUV planes to the compositor.
