labels.symptom: On odd-sized layers, GPU effects show small colour errors, especially when alpha is inverted.
labels.root_cause: Interpolated vertex coordinates sampled slightly wrong pixel centres for effect inputs.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be switched to Japanese.
Memory use keeps growing while seeking through many clips on the timeline.
labels.root_cause: Navigation bursts kept every clip's decoder and cached frames counted as in use.

labels.symptom: Importing many 4K clips makes memory use jump to several GB while thumbnails are generated.
labels.root_cause: Thumbnail requests used full-size multi-threaded decoders, six at once, and kept them cached.

labels.symptom: Hardware NVIDIA video encoding is unavailable on Linux, so exports use slower software encoding.
The Linux tarball has no installer, so users must copy bin and share by hand.
labels.root_cause: The Linux package shipped no install script.

labels.symptom: Captions with invalid TTML frame or tick rates import with wrong timing and no error.
labels.root_cause: Invalid timing parameters were silently replaced with defaults.

labels.symptom: On Linux, file open and save dialogs hide files with upper-case or mixed-case extensions such as .MP4.
labels.root_cause: rfd passes extensions as *.ext globs to the portal, GTK or Zenity, and these globs match case-sensitively.

labels.symptom: File > Export menu entries fail with a missing path error instead of asking for a destination.
labels.root_cause: Menu entries invoke commands with no parameters, and the export commands require a path.

labels.symptom: In exported FCP7 XML, a clip's source span differs from its record span by a frame.
labels.root_cause: In, out, start and end were each rounded to frames independently.

labels.symptom: In the browser build, exporting or importing a file traps the app and later commands hang.
labels.root_cause: The code used std::fs and atomic_write (std::process::id) directly instead of the host services, and these trap on wasm32.

labels.symptom: A reversed trimmed clip shows one frame past its range and never its In frame.
labels.root_cause: A time one tick before a frame boundary was rounded to the nearest frame by the MP4 reader.

labels.symptom: Dragging a clip edge on the timeline moves the clip instead of trimming it.
labels.root_cause: The hit-test ran only after the drag threshold, when the pointer had left the edge zone.

labels.symptom: Automation screenshots and element queries return stale or still-animating UI state right after an edit.
labels.root_cause: The control server captured the screen without waiting for pending frames and animations to settle.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be shown in Ukrainian.
On Linux, video decoding and export run only on the CPU because hardware acceleration is unavailable.
Video cannot be exported as AV1.
Memory use climbs to many gigabytes with several video clips on a timeline, and hardware decoding is never used.
labels.root_cause: Media files were read whole into memory, every source kept its decoder forever, and hardware decode was never enabled in the desktop app.

labels.symptom: Clippy fails CI on Rust 1.99 because of chunks_exact in a test.
labels.root_cause: Rust 1.99's clippy::chunks_exact_to_as_chunks lint rejects chunks_exact(4) when warnings are denied.

labels.symptom: On Windows, moving or relinking a project fails because paths don't match.
labels.root_cause: Native backslash paths were compared with slash-separated strings, and Ctrl/Cmd shortcuts collided per platform.

labels.symptom: Exported AAF files are rejected by independent readers like pyaaf2 with a missing ClassDefinitions index stream error.
labels.root_cause: The MetaDictionary was written with no ClassDefinitions/TypeDefinitions sets, and empty sets wrote a zero key size.

labels.symptom: Audio from MP4/MOV files at a different sample rate from the sequence plays and exports with loud, repeating spikes.
labels.root_cause: The resample path applied the MP4 edit-list offset twice, so interpolation extrapolated from before sample zero.

labels.symptom: A Flatpak built from source has no CLI or MCP server.
labels.root_cause: The from-source Flatpak manifest built and installed only the desktop app.

labels.symptom: Export renders frames on the CPU only, and some effects don't run on the GPU compositor.
The Sequence Settings dialog has no field to rename the sequence.
Source media cannot be played with sound or dragged to the timeline as a marked range.
The camera buttons on the Source and Program monitors do nothing instead of exporting a frame.
AV1 oracle tests fail instead of skipping when ffmpeg lacks libsvtav1 or libdav1d.
labels.root_cause: Tests only checked that ffmpeg existed, not its encoders/decoders.

labels.symptom: CI clippy fails on Rust 1.99 with the chunks_exact_to_as_chunks lint.
labels.root_cause: A new clippy lint rejects chunks_exact(4) when warnings are denied.

labels.symptom: There is no shared manifest of real-world media files for import/export round-trip tests.
A project saved after importing an interchange file cannot be reopened and reports it is damaged.
labels.root_cause: NaN auto-point sentinels from imported effects were serialized as null, and the reader rejected null.

labels.symptom: The UI stalls when editing large projects.
labels.root_cause: Every edit and undo snapshot cloned the full contents of every sequence.

labels.symptom: Zooming the timeline pushes the playhead out of view.
labels.root_cause: Timeline zoom did not anchor on the playhead position.

labels.symptom: The same media file can be imported several times, which makes the project lag.
labels.root_cause: Import does not check whether the file is already in the project, even when the path is written differently.

labels.symptom: A command naming a track that doesn't exist silently edits the default track instead.
labels.root_cause: The track-parameter helper fell back to the default track for unknown names.

labels.symptom: On Windows, HEVC hardware encoding writes inverted frame-rate timing and a translation test fails in CRLF checkouts.
labels.root_cause: NVENC VUI timing was set explicitly with swapped values, and the test scanner looked only for LF line endings.

labels.symptom: Dialogs use inconsistent headers, button styles and alignment.
labels.root_cause: There are no shared dialog styling helpers, so each dialog styles itself.

labels.symptom: Anamorphic clips with non-square pixels look squeezed.
labels.root_cause: The pixel aspect ratio was read on import but never used afterwards.

labels.symptom: HDR and colour info are wrong for MP4/MKV files without a container colour tag.
labels.root_cause: Importer read only container colour boxes and ignored bitstream VUI/sequence header.

labels.symptom: With the interface set to Japanese, only the menus are translated and panels, dialogs and tooltips stay in English.
labels.root_cause: The Japanese catalog had only menu entries, some of them copied from other apps' menus.

labels.symptom: Moving a clip by command leaves its linked sound behind, out of sync.
labels.root_cause: timeline.move ignored Linked Selection partners.

labels.symptom: With the interface in Japanese or another CJK language, panel tab labels overlap each other.
labels.root_cause: Tab widths were estimated at a fixed 7 px per character instead of being measured from the drawn label.

labels.symptom: After the hardware video decoder fails partway through, frames are lost or decoding errors out.
labels.root_cause: The software fallback replay stopped at the first sample the software decoder rejected, dropping the pictures already decoded.

labels.symptom: Sequence markers cannot be exported to a CSV file.
Exporting with an unknown interchange format writes FCP7 XML and reports success.
labels.root_cause: Unknown format strings fell through to the XML default instead of being rejected.

labels.symptom: The render_frame automation command with max_side 0 fails with 'render scale 0 must be finite and positive' instead of returning a full-size image.
labels.root_cause: The render scale was computed as max divided by the longest side without treating 0 as no limit.
bug_markers: render scale 0 must be finite and positive

labels.symptom: In FCP7 XML export, every audio clip is written as source channel 1, so the right channel of split stereo audio is lost.
labels.root_cause: The exporter hardcoded sourcetrack trackindex 1, and the importer never read it.

labels.symptom: AAF/OMF exports merge different audio streams from the same file into one.
labels.root_cause: The selected container audio stream was not part of decoding, essence identity and composition memoization.

labels.symptom: Running with --help or an unknown option opens the app instead of printing usage, and a bad control port is silently ignored.
labels.root_cause: The launcher ignored arguments it didn't recognise and invalid values.

labels.symptom: Pressing on a graph handle makes the value jump before the pointer moves.
labels.root_cause: The initial drag offset was not computed from the press position.

labels.symptom: The audio of a video clip cannot be edited, and the volume line cannot be dragged.
On Linux with NVIDIA, the UI freezes and frames drop at clip changes or when deleting clips.
labels.root_cause: Each VA-API decoder opened and terminated its own display.

labels.symptom: Linux users have no Flatpak repository to install and update the app from.
labels.root_cause: Releases ship only standalone Flatpak bundles with no hosted OSTree repository.

labels.symptom: An automation agent cannot read back a clip's end, its audio gain or a marker's comment to check its edits.
labels.root_cause: The sequence inspect readback left out clip end, gain and marker comment fields.

labels.symptom: Hardware video exports are slow because colour conversion runs on the CPU.
labels.root_cause: RGB to YUV conversion competed with rendering on the CPU thread pool.

labels.symptom: While you drag a transition onto a clip, the whole clip is outlined and you can't see which edge or span it will land on.
On Windows checkouts with CRLF line endings, the translation source-scan test fails with 'use a plain string literal in tl! and tlf!'.
labels.root_cause: The test cut source files at an LF-only '#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests' marker, which never matched CRLF files.

labels.symptom: The same color theme has different names in the View menu and in Settings.
labels.root_cause: The menu label for the middle theme was inconsistent with the settings label.

labels.symptom: Replacing a clip from the bin always starts at the new media's In point, so keeping the current source In takes an extra slip.
iPhone and cropped MP4 videos import at the wrong size and show a wider view than other players.
labels.root_cause: The SPS crop and the clean aperture were ignored.

labels.symptom: Stepping frame by frame stalls at some frame rates, such as 31 fps.
labels.root_cause: Stepping used time arithmetic instead of frame indices, and Tick arithmetic could overflow.

labels.symptom: Premiere project files and effect presets cannot be imported.
On Windows, exported files reference media with file:// URLs like file://%3F/C:/..., so other apps show the media as offline.
labels.root_cause: Windows verbatim paths (\\?\) from canonicalize were not stripped before URL conversion, so '?' became the URL host.

labels.symptom: Importing AIFF audio files fails with 'unsupported media: end of stream'.
labels.root_cause: The symphonia dependency was built with only the wav reader feature enabled.

labels.symptom: Replacing a clip with shorter media gives no warning that the clip will end on a frozen frame.
labels.root_cause: The command result didn't report clips that run past their media.

labels.symptom: CI workflows show Node 20 deprecation warnings.
labels.root_cause: Outdated GitHub Actions versions.

labels.symptom: No RISC-V Linux packages (deb, rpm, tar.gz) are published for releases.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow has no riscv64 cross-compile and packaging job.

labels.symptom: Applied transitions cannot be selected, edited, deleted or resized.
labels.root_cause: The timeline had no hit-testing or selection for transitions.

labels.symptom: Users who installed a release can't find how to register the CLI as an MCP server.
labels.root_cause: Docs only covered source builds; installers don't put the CLI on PATH.

labels.symptom: The app can't follow the system light/dark appearance or keep separate light and dark themes.
After saving and reopening a project, every sequence's playhead is back at zero.
labels.root_cause: Playheads for each sequence were not saved in the project's view state.

labels.symptom: The automation media-import tool only accepts a single text string instead of a list of paths.
labels.root_cause: The tool schema was a generic text parameter instead of mirroring file.import.

labels.symptom: Exporting to an interchange format silently drops title clips and adjustment layers without saying so in the report.
labels.root_cause: Exporters did not add a report entry for graphic clips and adjustment layers they could not carry.

labels.symptom: Toggling Enable on a mix of enabled and disabled clips sets them all to the same state instead of flipping each one.
labels.root_cause: The enable command applied one shared state to every clip in the selection.

labels.symptom: The app is not listed in the Omarchy OmaStore catalog.
Shapes and text can only have a solid fill, not a linear gradient.
Linking several video and audio clips puts them all into one link instead of one link per pair.
labels.root_cause: clip.link gave every selected clip the same single link id.

labels.symptom: Long lists in the media dialog run off the screen because they cannot be scrolled.
labels.root_cause: The dialog's media rows and candidates list had no scroll area.

labels.symptom: Files dragged from the OS are not placed where they are dropped, and on Windows the pointer position is unknown during a file drag.
labels.root_cause: winit sends no cursor events while files are dragged over the window on Windows.

labels.symptom: There is no eyedropper for picking a key colour straight from the footage.
Scripted commands that name their targets still fail with "nothing selected".
labels.root_cause: Command enablement is checked against the UI selection before parameters are read.

labels.symptom: Setting an effect parameter through automation does not accept option names and silently ignores the keyframe time.
The automation command list does not show that shape commands accept time and track parameters, and placement errors always name the text command.
labels.root_cause: The shared placement function hard-coded one command name in its errors, and the shape commands' parameter strings were incomplete.

labels.symptom: Dragging a color or number property creates one undo step per frame.
labels.root_cause: The panel sent graphics.set on every frame, with no merge or begin flags.

labels.symptom: On Linux with NVIDIA, hardware video decoding only works if libva-nvidia-driver is installed.
labels.root_cause: There was no NVDEC backend.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be shown in Simplified Chinese, and Chinese text shows as boxes.
On GNOME Wayland the window title bar is a plain fallback bar that ignores the desktop theme, dark mode and button layout.
labels.root_cause: eframe built with default-features = false drops winit's wayland-csd-adwaita feature, so winit draws its plain fallback client-side decorations.

labels.symptom: In the light theme some panels and controls stay dark.
labels.root_cause: Panels used hard-coded colours instead of theme tokens.

labels.symptom: Listing captions with an unknown track returns every caption track instead of an error.
labels.root_cause: A track selector that matched nothing became None, which the filter treated as no filter.

labels.symptom: Exporting a selected bin as a project reports success but writes an empty project.
labels.root_cause: The export closure kept the bin id rather than expanding the bin to the items it holds, so every real item was pruned.

labels.symptom: Rolling a cut between reversed clips changes the wrong source ranges.
labels.root_cause: roll() updated reversed clips' source ranges and clamps as if they played forward.

labels.symptom: Trims on reversed clips refuse valid extensions and allow extensions beyond the media end.
labels.root_cause: clamp_trim used forward-playback media limits for reversed clips.

labels.symptom: A ripple trim leaves a later split edit's sound behind, so it goes out of sync.
labels.root_cause: ripple_trim_group didn't shift linked clips that start before the cut.

labels.symptom: Extending several selected edit points to the playhead leaves some points past the playhead.
labels.root_cause: One delta computed from the first edit point was applied to all selected points.

labels.symptom: Slipping a linked picture and sound pair with different durations puts them out of sync.
labels.root_cause: Each linked partner was slipped and clamped independently instead of using one shared delta.

labels.symptom: Trimming the In point of a frame-held clip past the previous clip fails with an overlap error instead of clamping.
labels.root_cause: clamp_trim replaced the whole lower bound with Tick::MIN for held clips, dropping the previous-clip limit.

labels.symptom: Export settings given with camelCase nested keys like audio sample rate are silently ignored and defaults are used.
labels.root_cause: Deep-merge of caller settings added camelCase keys beside snake_case defaults, so serde ignored them.

labels.symptom: Moving a queued export by a huge relative offset fails with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: The target index addition overflowed before clamping.

labels.symptom: Replacing footage keeps the old file's duration, size and frame rate.
labels.root_cause: A forced relink threw away the opened source, so the candidate had no info.

labels.symptom: Collecting a project leaves out the source media of nested subclips.
labels.root_cause: used_ranges marked only the immediate parent of a subclip as used.

labels.symptom: The command-line tool exits with panic status 101 when its stderr pipe is closed, even after successful work.
labels.root_cause: eprintln! panics when writing to a closed stderr.

labels.symptom: Command-line export with only a start or end bound silently exports the whole sequence.
labels.root_cause: CLI forwarded range bounds only when both were present.

labels.symptom: The command-line render reports 'no sequence' when the render scale is invalid.
labels.root_cause: The CLI used an Option-returning render call that discarded the error reason.

labels.symptom: Ripple delete on a clip with a split edit closes two gaps or is refused.
labels.root_cause: The picture and sound ranges were treated as separate gaps.

labels.symptom: Most Parametric Equalizer controls are saved but have no effect on the audio.
labels.root_cause: An explicit mapping arm sent the effect to the three-band simple_eq DSP and ignored the full EQ mapping.

labels.symptom: Audio peak and normalization use the first audio stream for clips taken from a secondary stream.
labels.root_cause: clip_peaks always read stream 0 via src.audio instead of the clip's stream.

labels.symptom: Adding a vertex to an animated mask path crashes with an internal error.
labels.root_cause: The insertion index was computed after the path grew, and an empty path underflowed len()-1.

labels.symptom: Exported MCC caption files show no captions in FFmpeg.
labels.root_cause: The ancillary packet was missing its trailing SMPTE ST 291 checksum byte.

labels.symptom: Previous-word navigation crashes after the transcript gets shorter.
labels.root_cause: The stored word selection was not checked against the new transcript length before indexing.

labels.symptom: Sliding a clip gives reversed neighbouring clips the wrong source ranges.
labels.root_cause: slide trimmed neighbours as if they always played forward.

labels.symptom: The timecode readouts only display the time; you can't drag them to scrub or click them to type a time.
A ripple speed change on a linked clip moves later clips twice or is refused.
labels.root_cause: The picture and its linked sound each rippled on their own.

labels.symptom: On Windows there is no easy way to launch a source build with debug logs collected for troubleshooting.
Importing a crafted AAF file hangs or crashes from running out of memory.
labels.root_cause: A weak-reference collection with a key size of zero made the importer loop a file-controlled count with nothing to stop it.

labels.symptom: Opening or sniffing a small crafted compound file (such as an AAF) hangs for a long time or crashes from running out of memory.
labels.root_cause: The DIFAT and FAT chain-walk loop limits came from values in the file instead of the file's real size.

labels.symptom: In a Japanese UI without the bundled fonts, shared kanji are drawn with the Chinese system font instead of the Japanese one.
labels.root_cause: The Japanese system font was inserted at the lowest fallback priority, after the Chinese fallback.

labels.symptom: A reversed clip reads back from the sequence inspect command exactly like a forward clip.
labels.root_cause: The sequence inspect readback left out the clip's reverse flag.

labels.symptom: Linking several video/audio clip pairs puts all clips in one link so selecting one selects all.
labels.root_cause: clip.link allocated a single link id for every selected clip.

labels.symptom: Slipping linked picture and sound clips with the keyboard puts them out of sync.
labels.root_cause: Keyboard slip slipped each clip on its own instead of clamping the linked clips by one shared delta.

labels.symptom: The CLI's MCP server accepts unknown options such as --automation-read-root without error, so it looks sandboxed when it is not.
labels.root_cause: The mcp subcommand's argument parser silently ignored any option it did not recognise.

labels.symptom: Clicking the dB readout under an audio clip mixer strip does not let you type a volume.
labels.root_cause: The readout was a plain painted label instead of an editable hot_number widget.

labels.symptom: Transparent areas of WebM VP9 videos with alpha show as black.
labels.root_cause: The Matroska reader detected AlphaMode but never read BlockAdditions, so the separately coded VP9 alpha stream was never decoded.

labels.symptom: The app freezes on the first frame of a drag in a panel.
labels.root_cause: drag_delta() was called inside a data_mut() closure, so egui's non-reentrant context lock was taken twice and the app deadlocked.

labels.symptom: Exporting with start and end times but no range renders the whole sequence.
labels.root_cause: range_param ignored bare start and end times unless range was set to custom.

labels.symptom: Placing an item on an audio track by command puts it on the wrong tracks.
labels.root_cause: The track parameter was always treated as the video destination.

labels.symptom: H.264 exports offer only CBR or VBR bitrate modes, with no constant-quality (CRF) option.
labels.root_cause: Export settings never exposed the encoder's existing CRF rate control, and the level for uncapped streams was picked from frame size and rate alone.

labels.symptom: On Linux, while a file dialog is open the window freezes and GNOME shows a 'not responding' prompt.
labels.root_cause: Blocking rfd file dialogs wait for the XDG portal on the UI thread, which stops the frame loop.

labels.symptom: Exporting WAV or AIFF audio larger than 4 GiB crashes or writes a corrupt file.
labels.root_cause: File sizes were stored in u32 with unchecked arithmetic, and the whole file was built in memory first.

labels.symptom: Dragging in empty space in the Project panel does not draw a selection rectangle.
labels.root_cause: Synthetic input also did not send modifier changes around pointer presses.

labels.symptom: Pressing Escape during a drag drops the item where the pointer is instead of cancelling the drag.
labels.root_cause: egui ends a drag when Escape is pressed, and the app treated that as a normal release.

labels.symptom: On Windows PCs whose GPUs come from different driver packages, the app crashes on launch with an access violation before the window appears.
labels.root_cause: The Vulkan loader lists one GPU through two drivers, and wgpu's default adapter request picks the first (stale) driver entry, which then crashes.

labels.symptom: The Windows Start Menu shortcut and Add/Remove Programs icon are blank, and a console window opens behind the app.
labels.root_cause: The MSI Icon Id lacked an .ico/.exe extension, and release builds used the console subsystem.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Russian.
Some interface labels stay in English when a Chinese interface language is chosen.
labels.root_cause: UI strings were hardcoded and not passed through the translation lookup.

labels.symptom: Audio cannot be exported as FLAC.
Images and files copied in other apps cannot be pasted with Ctrl+V.
labels.root_cause: Paste only handled the app's own internal clipboard content.

labels.symptom: Dev builds fill the disk, with the target directory growing to tens of gigabytes in a single day.
labels.root_cause: Full DWARF debuginfo in dozens of statically linked test binaries, plus incremental build caches that are never cleaned up.

labels.symptom: Export can crash the app instead of reporting an error.
labels.root_cause: expect() and unreachable!() calls in production export code panic.

labels.symptom: A bin cannot be deleted from the Project panel.
labels.root_cause: The UI never sent the bin's id to the delete command.

labels.symptom: In the browser build, exporting many files at once downloads only some of them.
labels.root_cause: A download link was clicked for every file in the same instant and Chrome dropped the bursts.

labels.symptom: Media files that grow or are re-rendered on disk don't update in the project.
labels.root_cause: The auto-refresh setting for growing files was listed but not wired up.

labels.symptom: While a clip is being trimmed, its waveform squeezes instead of staying in place.
labels.root_cause: The clip was drawn from the untrimmed item during the trim preview.

labels.symptom: 10-bit or 4:2:2 H.264 camera footage imports but shows black frames with no error.
labels.root_cause: The H.264 decoder only supported 8-bit 4:2:0 and failed frames were dropped silently.

labels.symptom: The Windows Start Menu shortcut and Add/Remove Programs icon are blank, and a console window opens behind the app.
labels.root_cause: The MSI Icon Id lacked an .ico/.exe extension, and release builds used the console subsystem.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in German.
Text-based editing with local Whisper transcription and an MCP server are not available.
In VMs or containers without GPU access, rendering runs on the CPU with heavy lag and nothing explains why.
labels.root_cause: wgpu silently fell back to a software rasterizer such as llvmpipe, which was accepted as a GPU adapter.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland desktops, dragging files from the file manager onto the window shows a prohibited cursor and nothing is dropped.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 does not implement drag-and-drop on Wayland, so the app has to run through XWayland.

labels.symptom: On macOS, double-clicking a project in Finder or running open -a launches the app without opening the file.
labels.root_cause: Info.plist declares no CFBundleDocumentTypes, and the kAEOpenDocuments Apple event is never handled because winit 0.30 doesn't support it.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking empty space in the Project panel's Icon view does nothing once the project has items.
labels.root_cause: Only the strip below the last row of cards sensed clicks; the rows were hover-only.

labels.symptom: After importing an FCP7 XML project, every clip sits at the top level and its bins are empty.
labels.root_cause: A media item stayed where it was first seen (inside a sequence) and was never moved into its master clip's bin.

labels.symptom: Sony camera MP4 clips show no start timecode, so syncing by timecode fails.
labels.root_cause: Only tmcd tracks were read and the start timecode in Sony's rtmd metadata track was ignored.

labels.symptom: Exporting a selection from a large project is very slow.
labels.root_cause: closure() walked the whole bin tree once for every queued id, giving quadratic work.

labels.symptom: AVI video files cannot be imported.
labels.root_cause: No AVI container demuxer exists.

labels.symptom: Automation commands given explicit clip ids fail with a misleading 'no clips selected' error.
labels.root_cause: The selection check error did not say why the named ids were not clips of the active sequence.

labels.symptom: Select All in the Project panel also selects items in closed or hidden bins.
labels.root_cause: project.selectAll selected every project item and ignored which bin was shown.

labels.symptom: Clicking one keyframe highlights every keyframe at that time.
labels.root_cause: The highlight was based on the keyframe time matching the playhead, not on a real selection.

labels.symptom: Clicking help or report-an-issue links does not open the web browser.
labels.root_cause: eframe was built without the links feature, so open_url only logged a warning and opened nothing.
bug_markers: Cannot open url - feature links not enabled

labels.symptom: Exporting WAV at an explicit sample rate silently produces a file at the sequence rate.
labels.root_cause: Export settings resolution replaced the requested rate with the sequence rate.

labels.symptom: Exports with rotated phone video clips sometimes stop making frames and never finish.
labels.root_cause: Frames were rotated with rayon while the frame-cache lock was held, which caused a deadlock on the global rayon pool.

labels.symptom: Dragging a clip edge stretches it past the end of its media until you let go.
labels.root_cause: The drag preview showed the raw pointer delta instead of the clamped trim delta.

labels.symptom: Importing an XML or OTIO sequence takes over a minute because every media file is read whole.
labels.root_cause: Interchange import linked media by reading each file fully into memory instead of using the streaming reader.

labels.symptom: Applying a Fade In and then a Fade Out to the same clip leaves only the second fade.
labels.root_cause: Applying a preset replaced the intrinsic Opacity effect wholesale and wiped its existing keyframes.

labels.symptom: Video playback and GPU export are slow on Apple Silicon.
Position, scale and rotation can't be adjusted with on-screen handles in the program monitor.
Header controls overlap and UI text uses a bundled font instead of the system font.
labels.root_cause: Fixed header spacing and forced bundled Inter font.

labels.symptom: DaVinci Resolve project files cannot be imported.
Resetting an effect deletes its keyframes, and single properties have no reset button.
labels.root_cause: The effect reset replaced the effect with a fresh instance.

labels.symptom: The interface is too large on scaled Linux desktops, and there is no setting that saves a different UI scale.
labels.root_cause: There was no UI scale preference; the app always used the scale the system reported.

labels.symptom: On macOS 11 and 12 the app aborts at launch with a dyld 'Symbol not found' error.
labels.root_cause: A framework symbol that only exists from macOS 13 was linked directly instead of being looked up at run time with dlsym.

labels.symptom: Changing the Hard Limiter's look-ahead time has no effect on the processed audio.
labels.root_cause: The stored look-ahead parameter was never passed to the DSP limiter, which used a fixed 5 ms window.

labels.symptom: Choosing Relaxed or Aggressive for the Ultra Key Setting barely changes the matte, so clothing turns partly transparent.
labels.root_cause: The Setting only scaled two internal multipliers and did not apply a preset of matte parameters.

labels.symptom: Headless import merges into the existing project, so exports also contain the old content.
labels.root_cause: file.import always merged into the current project.

labels.symptom: Files with uppercase extensions such as .MOV or .JPG can't be imported on Linux.
labels.root_cause: Extension matching assumed lowercase suffixes.

labels.symptom: The Transform effect's shutter angle never adds motion blur.
labels.root_cause: There was no override option, so the effect's shutter angle was never used.

labels.symptom: There is no command that deletes a project bin; passing a bin id does nothing.
labels.root_cause: project.delete only accepted item ids.

labels.symptom: The effect controls panel has no row separators, its divider is fixed and scrolling is limited.
Export cannot produce ProRes 4444 or 4444 XQ, and graphics lose their transparency.
labels.root_cause: Export mapped unknown ProRes profiles to HQ and always built 4:2:2 frames without alpha.

labels.symptom: Position keyframes don't offer the value and velocity graphs that scalar parameters have.
labels.root_cause: The graph twirl-down only supported Float parameters, not Vec2.

labels.symptom: Deleting one side of a linked audio/video clip also deletes its partner.
labels.root_cause: Delete expanded the selection to linked partners, and Alt-click left both clips selected.

labels.symptom: A dialog with long file paths grows wider than the screen and its action buttons can't be reached.
labels.root_cause: Dialog width wasn't limited to the viewport and the body didn't scroll separately from the buttons.

labels.symptom: The monitor's Button Editor (+) button does nothing when clicked.
labels.root_cause: The button's click event was never handled.

labels.symptom: Timeline tracks cannot be renamed from the UI.
labels.root_cause: Track headers had no rename control even though the command supported it.

labels.symptom: No native Windows ARM64 installer is offered.
labels.root_cause: The release pipeline built only x64 Windows binaries.

labels.symptom: A shortcut with a modifier, like Shift+Delete, does the action of the plain key when a panel has its own binding for that key.
labels.root_cause: Panel bindings were tried before app-wide ones and egui consume_key ignores extra Shift/Alt, so less specific bindings matched first.

labels.symptom: Importing a long WAV file freezes the window and uses memory equal to the file size.
labels.root_cause: WAV had no streaming reader, so the whole file was read into memory on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: On macOS the app never asks for microphone permission and records no audio input.
labels.root_cause: Info.plist lacks NSMicrophoneUsageDescription and the hardened-runtime entitlements lack audio-input.

labels.symptom: Large projects with hundreds of media files show media as offline or failed once the open-file limit is hit.
labels.root_cause: Each media reader kept its own file descriptor open for its whole lifetime.

labels.symptom: Timeline video clips show only one thumbnail at the head even when zoomed in.
labels.root_cause: Thumbnail display was a simple on/off boolean with only the head frame.

labels.symptom: Clicking empty space does not deselect, and typing goes to the text being edited instead of the clicked field.
labels.root_cause: Empty areas had no deselect handling and the text editor grabbed keyboard focus every frame.

labels.symptom: After ripple trim, roll, slide or ripple speed edits, transitions stay at their old positions instead of following their cuts.
labels.root_cause: These edits moved clips but did not shift the transitions anchored to them.

labels.symptom: The progress and parity docs are out of date.
J/K/L in the Source monitor only plays forward at normal speed.
labels.root_cause: The Source playback clock only supported 1x forward speed.
bug_markers: Source playback currently supports normal forward speed

labels.symptom: Importing a folder from the media browser drops only its top-level files flat and loses the sub-folder structure.
labels.root_cause: Folder import only collected first-level files and never created bins for sub-folders.

labels.symptom: Timeline track separators are invisible and the playhead head covers markers on the ruler.
labels.root_cause: Track lines were drawn in the background colour, and the playhead head spanned the full height of the ruler.

labels.symptom: A gap between clips cannot be selected and closed with Delete or Backspace.
Importing malformed subtitle files can give caption times that wrap to unrelated values.
labels.root_cause: TTML times were cast to i64 without overflow checks, and clock rounding could overflow.

labels.symptom: Caption text with literal angle brackets loses part of its content on subtitle export.
labels.root_cause: The STL encoder treated any text between < and > as markup and dropped unrecognised tags.

labels.symptom: Captions always render in the default font, whatever font the caption track is set to.
labels.root_cause: The burn-in renderer hard-coded Inter SemiBold and ignored the track's font.

labels.symptom: The roadmap wrongly said hardware decode was active in earlier releases.
Typing into the hex colour field in Settings snaps every character back to the saved colour.
labels.root_cause: The field was refilled from the saved value every frame and kept an edit only when the whole text was already a valid colour.

labels.symptom: Extra caption tracks cannot be deleted from the interface.
Narration reads some numbers, percentages and dollar amounts wrongly.
labels.root_cause: The text normalizer dropped interior number groups, missed % after decimals or spaces, and read a single-digit fraction as cents.

labels.symptom: Named audio crossfades imported from an EDL turn into Constant Power and get a false unsupported warning.
labels.root_cause: Transition names were resolved against video effects before the destination track kind was known.

labels.symptom: The settings schema reports a preference as active when it has no effect.
labels.root_cause: The preference was marked wired: true although no behaviour was implemented for it.

labels.symptom: Speech transcription freezes the editor, and speaker assignments in the transcript can't be corrected.
labels.root_cause: Transcription ran synchronously on the UI thread, and redraws copied sequences again and again.

labels.symptom: A command-line option given its value after a space loses that value or treats it as a filename.
labels.root_cause: The option was missing from the CLI parser's list of options that take a value.

labels.symptom: An MP4 without an edit list repeats its opening frame and drops its last pictures.
labels.root_cause: The raw first PTS, which includes the composition delay, was kept as the media origin.

labels.symptom: Imported 5.1 AAC audio plays with the centre, LFE and surround channels on the wrong speakers.
labels.root_cause: The AAC decoder output was left in AAC element order instead of being reordered to WAV/SMPTE order.

labels.symptom: The keyframe view in Effect Controls cannot be zoomed or panned, so closely spaced keyframes are hard to edit.
labels.root_cause: The panel always showed the clip's full duration and had no time viewport of its own.

labels.symptom: The command-line tool fails with 'missing subcommand' when --version comes after a global option.
labels.root_cause: --version was recognised only as the first argument.

labels.symptom: Dragging a shape's handles changes its scale instead of resizing the shape itself.
AV1 files encoded with SVT-AV1 always use software decoding instead of the hardware decoder.
labels.root_cause: Sequence headers were compared byte for byte, and SVT-AV1 writes a provisional av1C header whose coding tool flags differ from the in-band one.

labels.symptom: AV1 can't be chosen as an export format.
Sliding linked picture and sound with the keyboard can move them by different amounts.
labels.root_cause: Each selected item was clamped on its own instead of all items sharing one common delta.

labels.symptom: Markers placed on the timeline cannot be selected or deleted.
labels.root_cause: A click on a marker scrubbed to the pointer instead of the marker, and a right-click opened the clip menu.

labels.symptom: Changing the highlight colour leaves most of the blue interface elements blue.
labels.root_cause: The highlight colour replaced only the accent token; other blue tokens were hard-coded.

labels.symptom: Importing a Matroska file whose timestamps do not start at zero freezes the opening frame and makes the clip longer than the media.
labels.root_cause: Raw Segment timestamps and the absolute duration were used as media time without subtracting the earliest start time.

labels.symptom: Dragging several selected project items onto the timeline places only one.
Positive vignette Roundness values do not change the shape of the vignette.
labels.root_cause: The horizontal coordinate was scaled by 1 + vround * 0.0, and aspect correction ran only for negative roundness.

labels.symptom: On macOS, double-clicking a project file in Finder fails with 'cannot open files of this type'.
labels.root_cause: Info.plist lacks CFBundleDocumentTypes, and winit does not pass on the open-documents Apple Event.

labels.symptom: A newly created bin gets a fixed default name and does not open a rename field.
labels.root_cause: file.newBin used a hard-coded name and never started the inline rename.

labels.symptom: There is nowhere to keep free-text notes inside a project.
Bins can't be dragged into other bins or back out of them.
Colour presets can't be dragged onto a timeline clip.
Dropping media in empty timeline space outside the existing tracks does nothing instead of creating a new track.
Transitions disappear when the clips they sit on are moved on the timeline.
labels.root_cause: Moving clips deleted them first, which removed their now-orphaned transitions.

labels.symptom: A clip's fade-in or fade-out stays behind when the clip's edge is trimmed.
labels.root_cause: Only ripple trims moved transitions, so a regular trim left one-sided fades where they were.

labels.symptom: Exporting a still frame right after seeking in the browser saves a blank or transparent image.
labels.root_cause: The frame export did not check whether async WebCodecs decodes or Blob reads were still pending before writing the image.

labels.symptom: Quitting or closing the window with unsaved changes exits without asking to save, so the next launch always offers recovery.
labels.root_cause: The close request was not intercepted to cancel the close and show a save prompt when the document had unsaved changes.

labels.symptom: After maximizing a panel from its menu there is no way to restore the layout, and closing the last panel leaves an empty dock that no panel can be reopened into.
labels.root_cause: Maximize replaced the whole dock tree instead of toggling a maximized state, and open_near only inserted next to neighbours that no longer existed.

labels.symptom: Exporting with GPU rendering on Auto is slower than with it Off when the timeline has adjustment layers or complex transitions.
labels.root_cause: Frames that the planner returns as one CPU image were still rendered inside the small GPU renderer pool, which limited how many could run at once.

labels.symptom: A command-line tool built on its own crashes or fails when GPU rendering is enabled.
labels.root_cause: The wgpu dependency has default features off, so a build without the app has no backend and wgpu::Instance::default panics.

labels.symptom: Video in an unsupported format renders black with no error.
labels.root_cause: Unsupported-format decoder errors were turned into generic decode errors, and the renderer silently dropped the failed frames.

labels.symptom: The Source monitor forgets previously opened clips and cannot close them.
In the web build, playback drops many frames because parallel work runs on a single thread.
labels.root_cause: The wasm build has no thread pool, so rayon runs inline on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: A rectangle's corners cannot be rounded by dragging on the canvas.
Double-clicking a timeline clip does not open it in the Source monitor.
Some tests panic on integer overflow or fail on fast machines.
labels.root_cause: A seed multiplication used checked arithmetic, and the export progress test depended on timing.

labels.symptom: Open-GOP video shows black frames after a trim or seek.
labels.root_cause: Decoding started at the CRA that follows the RASL pictures, so those leading pictures were never produced.

labels.symptom: On macOS the app holds gigabytes of memory from launch with nothing open.
labels.root_cause: The CJK system-font fallback read every system font file to check glyph coverage and kept each one in memory.

labels.symptom: Clips from multi-track audio files all show the first track's waveform.
labels.root_cause: Waveform peaks always read audio stream 0 and were cached per item only.

labels.symptom: Closing the only sequence removes the whole Timeline panel with no obvious way to get it back.
There is no repeatable way to measure menu parity against the reference app.
labels.root_cause: The menu coverage figure came from an ad hoc string-matching script.

labels.symptom: H.265 hardware export through NVENC is not available on Linux.
labels.root_cause: The HEVC NVENC factory was Windows-only, and probing beside VA-API could deadlock in cuInit.

labels.symptom: Render In to Out renders the whole clip or timeline instead of only the marked range.
labels.root_cause: Every render segment overlapping In/Out was rendered in full.

labels.symptom: Files with E-AC-3 (Dolby Digital Plus) audio import with no sound.
labels.root_cause: The AC-3 decoder rejected E-AC-3 bitstreams (bsid 11-16) as unsupported.

labels.symptom: Speed-changed clips set to Optical Flow interpolation show moving objects doubled, like frame blending.
labels.root_cause: Optical Flow interpolation was not implemented and fell back to cross-fading the neighbouring frames.

labels.symptom: Dragging a layer's transform handle scales it in the wrong direction, and the handles in the middle of each edge can't be grabbed.
labels.root_cause: Scaling happened about the layer's anchor instead of pinning the opposite side.

labels.symptom: Image sequences cannot be exported as JPEG, Targa or DPX.
labels.root_cause: Only PNG, TIFF and BMP sequence writers existed.

labels.symptom: Audio from Matroska files starts a few samples late compared with the source.
labels.root_cause: CodecDelay was rounded to 1 ms and packet starts were anchored on the rounded timestamp.

labels.symptom: Option-dragging a clip in the timeline moves it instead of duplicating it.
labels.root_cause: Timeline drag ignored the Option modifier.

labels.symptom: Effect Controls doesn't show a mini timeline for the selected transition.
Sliding a linked video clip leaves its audio behind, so audio and video go out of sync.
labels.root_cause: The slide command moved only the given clip and not its linked partners.

labels.symptom: The Edit > Label menu lists label names without their colour swatches.
labels.root_cause: The menu renderer did not draw the colour swatches for labels.

labels.symptom: Audio goes silent when shuttling forward at 2x speed or faster.
labels.root_cause: The audio startup path disabled audio whenever playback speed wasn't 1x.

labels.symptom: The interface isn't available in French.
labels.root_cause: There was no French translation catalog.

labels.symptom: MP2 audio in MP4 or MOV files plays as silence or fails to import.
labels.root_cause: MPEG audio in MP4 always got a layer III decoder, and the QuickTime .mp2 sample entry was not recognised.

labels.symptom: Japanese text in the interface depends on installed system fonts and does not work on the web.
The Morph Cut transition shows a double image instead of morphing between the shots.
labels.root_cause: Morph Cut was an alias of Cross Dissolve.

labels.symptom: Video can't be exported as an OpenEXR image sequence.
labels.root_cause: There was no OpenEXR writer or export format.

labels.symptom: Making a new bin and then pressing Clear deletes the clips that were still selected instead of the new bin.
labels.root_cause: New Bin did not clear the existing item selection.

labels.symptom: Toolbar and folder icons are inconsistent, and folder plates stay dark in the Light theme.
labels.root_cause: Folder plates used a hard-coded dark fill instead of the theme colour.

labels.symptom: Rectangle and polygon masks can't have rounded corners.
MP2 audio tracks at common bit rates such as mono 384 kbit/s play as silence.
labels.root_cause: symphonia rejects Layer II frames with bit rate/channel mode combinations the standard disallows.
bug_markers: invalid Layer 2 bitrate for mono channel mode

labels.symptom: Placing a sequence inside itself crashes the app with a stack overflow.
labels.root_cause: Nested audio mixing and the multi-camera frame plan recursed with no depth limit.

labels.symptom: The mouse wheel doesn't zoom the video monitors toward the pointer, and the middle button doesn't pan.
There is no way to export only the audio mix as an AAC file.
Targa and DPX stills and image sequences can't be imported.
labels.root_cause: No decoders for those formats were available.

labels.symptom: On some Intel or AMD graphics drivers the app crashes at every launch before its window opens.
labels.root_cause: A driver crash inside wgpu instance or device creation kills the process, and there is no automatic fallback to another backend or a software adapter.

labels.symptom: Video can't be exported as AV1 with NVIDIA hardware, and bad AV1 streams can crash decoding.
Videos stored with millisecond timestamps skip every third frame at 30 fps, so playback and export judder.
labels.root_cause: Frame lookup rounded the requested time down against timestamps that had been rounded to 1 ms.

labels.symptom: No Linux riscv64 release download is offered.
Clearing an aliased keyboard shortcut in the shortcut editor leaves it active.
labels.root_cause: The two aliased commands did not share bindings, so clearing one left the other's chord in place.

labels.symptom: Dropping a file from the file manager onto an empty timeline imports it but does not create a sequence.
labels.root_cause: The empty timeline never handled the pending drop.

labels.symptom: An audio effect applied to a linked audio/video clip does not show its controls.
labels.root_cause: The audio effect was applied to the video clip of the linked pair.

labels.symptom: The parity tool measures only the menu bar, not effects or transitions.
OpenEXR stills and image sequences cannot be imported.
labels.root_cause: No EXR reader existed.

labels.symptom: There is no software AV1 export.
Pasting with the keyboard after a cut pastes old clipboard files instead of the cut clips.
labels.root_cause: Paste preferred files left on the OS clipboard over the in-app clipboard.

labels.symptom: DPX stills with packed 10/12-bit or Y'CbCr data fail to import with an unsupported error.
labels.root_cause: The DPX reader did not handle packing 0 or Y'CbCr descriptors.

labels.symptom: No test runs a full import, edit and export job from start to finish.
Number fields accept only a plain number, so typing a calculation such as 100*2 is thrown away.
Export stops producing frames partway and hangs forever with HEVC clips.
labels.root_cause: Deadlock when clip decoding uses rayon while the decode cache lock is held.

labels.symptom: Playback goes silent after a second or two, or when the output device is unplugged, while the meters keep moving.
labels.root_cause: The first error of any kind from the cpal stream, including transient ALSA errors, permanently marked audio output as failed.

labels.symptom: There is no on-monitor handle to round the corners of rectangle or polygon masks.
Opening a file with an upper-case extension at launch treats it as the wrong type, relative launch paths go missing later, and a non-Unicode argument crashes the app at startup.
labels.root_cause: Launch args are matched with a case-sensitive ends_with, used without being made absolute, and read with std::env::args, which panics on non-Unicode.

labels.symptom: Panels cannot be dragged to rearrange them, and the layout is not remembered across launches.
Exports with adjustment layers are slow and can deadlock.
labels.root_cause: Nested Rayon work stealing exhausted the renderer pool, and adjustment layers were flattened on the CPU.

labels.symptom: Holding Shift does not constrain pen mask segments to 45° steps, and pen mask curves are committed as corners.
labels.root_cause: The pen ignored Shift, and path_from_json's serde parsing silently dropped the in/out tangent keys.

labels.symptom: Dropping files from the file manager onto an empty timeline imports them but creates no sequence.
labels.root_cause: The empty timeline did not handle pending OS file drops.

labels.symptom: An unknown marker colour name is accepted and silently stored as Green.
labels.root_cause: Colour parsing fell back to Green with unwrap_or.

labels.symptom: Audio mixing and effects use more CPU than they need to.
In Brazilian Portuguese most of the interface outside the menus is still in English.
labels.root_cause: The pt-br catalog covered only the menu strings.

labels.symptom: An unknown marker colour name is accepted and silently stored as Green.
labels.root_cause: Colour parsing fell back to Green with unwrap_or.

labels.symptom: Automation commands accept negative times, placing clips and markers before the sequence start.
labels.root_cause: There was no validation for negative frames.

labels.symptom: Rolling an edit moves the video cut but not the linked audio cut.
labels.root_cause: The roll edit ignored linked clips.

labels.symptom: An exported animated GIF plays slightly fast at non-integer frame delays such as 24 fps.
labels.root_cause: Each frame's delay was truncated to whole centiseconds, so the rounding error added up over the sequence.

labels.symptom: An exported animated GIF plays slightly fast at non-integer frame delays such as 24 fps.
labels.root_cause: Each frame's delay was truncated to whole centiseconds, so the rounding error added up over the sequence.

labels.symptom: Label submenus in right-click menus show bare default names with no colour swatches.
labels.root_cause: The context menus did not use the shared label drawing with user names and colours.

labels.symptom: Playback of long-GOP video stalls for a long time before the first frame appears after a seek.
labels.root_cause: GOP cache eviction was pinned to the newest decoded picture instead of the requested one, and preroll prefetched a full run.

labels.symptom: The interface cannot be switched to Indonesian.
labels.root_cause: There was no Indonesian catalog.

labels.symptom: OpenEXR export writes only uncompressed files.
labels.root_cause: There was no deflate encoder in the workspace.

labels.symptom: Video export can't use AMD hardware encoders or produce AV1 files with NVENC or in software.
Panels can now be docked, grouped and floated with shared layouts saved in workspaces.
H.264 decoding is slow because the 6-tap luma interpolation runs as scalar code.
labels.root_cause: The 6-tap luma kernel had no SIMD.

labels.symptom: H.264 video decoding is slower than it should be because the weighted prediction, chroma and IDCT steps run as scalar code.
labels.root_cause: Decoder kernels were scalar with no SIMD.

labels.symptom: Damaged media shows silent black frames in the monitors with no explanation.
labels.root_cause: Only Unsupported decoder errors were mapped to the unreadable slate, not repeated decode or I/O errors.

labels.symptom: AV1 video plays back slowly because its post-filters run on one thread.
labels.root_cause: postfilter::apply ignored the thread pool and ran deblocking, CDEF and loop restoration serially.

labels.symptom: IME input such as Vietnamese Telex or Korean cannot be typed into text fields because single-letter shortcuts take the keystrokes.
labels.root_cause: Unmodified single-key shortcuts are consumed before widgets run, and the focus check reads the previous frame's state.

labels.symptom: Reveal in Finder in the right-click menu cannot be selected.
labels.root_cause: There was no file.reveal command for opening the OS file manager.

labels.symptom: Installing a template file the app cannot read does nothing and shows no error.
labels.root_cause: The UI threw away the install command's error result (let _ = route(...)).

labels.symptom: Importing a video with several audio tracks brings in only the first track.
labels.root_cause: The MPEG-TS/PS demuxer probed only one audio PID.

labels.symptom: Undoing a single mouse drag on a value takes one undo for every small step instead of one undo.
labels.root_cause: The drag-session token in egui temp data was cleared on idle frames, so each new tick started a fresh undo step.

labels.symptom: License files and brand terms don't follow the shared licensing standard.
In the web build embedded in a host page, saved files become browser downloads instead of going back to the host.
Animated GIF and APNG files import as a still showing only the first frame.
labels.root_cause: The importer treated them as still images.

labels.symptom: On startup, recovery snapshots are deleted when their session metadata file is missing or unreadable, losing unsaved work.
labels.root_cause: Startup cleanup treated sessions with unreadable session.json as empty and deleted them despite a valid snapshot.

labels.symptom: After opening the demo project, Save overwrites the previously saved project file with the demo.
labels.root_cause: Opening the demo replaced the document but kept the previous session save path.

labels.symptom: Clips on a locked track can still be trimmed, slipped, slid, rolled or speed-changed.
labels.root_cause: Only clip moves checked the track lock; trim and timing edit commands did not.

labels.symptom: Changing the Hard Limiter Look-Ahead Time has no effect on limiting.
labels.root_cause: The DSP used a fixed 5 ms look-ahead window instead of the stored parameter.

labels.symptom: Dropping a media file on an empty timeline imports it but creates no sequence.
labels.root_cause: The empty-timeline state skips the handler that consumes pending file drops.

labels.symptom: RF64 WAV files with metadata after the audio report a longer duration and play the metadata as noise.
labels.root_cause: When the data size field holds the RF64 sentinel, the reader reads to end of file instead of using the ds64 dataSize.

labels.symptom: FCPXML point markers are imported as one-frame ranges.
labels.root_cause: Import compares the marker duration to one tick instead of one sequence frame.

labels.symptom: FCP7 XML export silently leaves out markers attached to source media.
labels.root_cause: The exporter writes only clipitem markers and never emits master clips for media markers.

labels.symptom: OTIO export loses or replaces markers on nested sequences.
labels.root_cause: Clip instance markers are written onto the nested sequence Stack and overwrite the sequence's own markers.

labels.symptom: Importing TTML captions whose paragraphs take their timing from a container produces an empty caption track.
labels.root_cause: The TTML parser requires an explicit begin on each paragraph and does not inherit container timing.

labels.symptom: Installing an unsupported graphics template from the panel button seems to do nothing and gives no error.
labels.root_cause: The panel's Install button calls route() directly and throws away its error result.

labels.symptom: Exported audio misses the requested loudness target when peak limiting kicks in.
labels.root_cause: Loudness was measured before the peak limiter, so the gain the limiter removed was never made up.

labels.symptom: An export can hang forever, and polling its job status stops responding.
labels.root_cause: There was no supervision of stalled export workers, and polling blocked on locks the worker held.

labels.symptom: Narration reads some numbers wrongly: 120th becomes 'twentieth', 7/100 is read with 'slash', and leading zeros are dropped from percentages and decimals.
labels.root_cause: Text normalization drops magnitude words for exact-tens ordinals, allows only two-digit fraction operands, and converts integers before keeping leading zeros.

labels.symptom: Playing a marked In-to-Out range leaves the playhead one frame past the Out point.
labels.root_cause: The exclusive stop boundary is also used as the playhead's resting position when playback ends.

labels.symptom: Noise grain repeats on consecutive frames at high frame rates.
labels.root_cause: The noise seed was quantised to 30 Hz with (seconds*30) as u64.

labels.symptom: The TIFF sequence export summary overstates the file size when alpha is off and doesn't change when alpha is turned on.
labels.root_cause: The size estimator always assumes four channels for TIFF output and ignores the alpha setting.

labels.symptom: Scripts moving timeline clips get no report of the clips that a move overwrote.
The interface theme does not follow the macOS light/dark appearance when it changes automatically.
labels.root_cause: Setting a concrete egui theme pins the native window appearance, so macOS appearance changes are no longer observed.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be shown in Korean or Traditional Chinese, and those scripts need fallback fonts.
Korean text shows as square boxes in text fields and the UI.
labels.root_cause: The UI font fallback list had no font with Hangul glyphs.

labels.symptom: PR CI takes 30-50 minutes because slow FreeBSD and Windows ARM64 jobs run on almost every PR.
labels.root_cause: These workflows were triggered by lockfile changes and by pushes to main.

labels.symptom: Changing clip speed without ripple shortens the clip but leaves the fade-out at the old end.
labels.root_cause: The non-ripple speed change did not move out-edge transitions to the new clip end.

labels.symptom: Moving a clip from a locked track says it worked but leaves the original in place and adds a duplicate with the same clip ID.
labels.root_cause: Move cloned the clip to the destination, then deleting from the locked source was skipped, and the source lock was never checked first.

labels.symptom: After trimming two selected edit points with one command, Undo restores only one clip.
labels.root_cause: Each per-point trim pushed its own history snapshot instead of being grouped into one undo step.

labels.symptom: A linked Rate Stretch gives the picture and sound clips different speeds when a neighbouring clip limits one of them.
labels.root_cause: Each linked partner was clamped against its own neighbour separately.

labels.symptom: Match Frame on a reversed clip picks the wrong source frame.
labels.root_cause: source_in was computed as if the clip played forward, ignoring reverse and speed.

labels.symptom: A rejected New Sequence dialog closes and loses the entered settings.
labels.root_cause: The dialog closed and dropped its draft even when the command failed.

labels.symptom: Starting the CLI MCP server with an invalid bridge address exits with status 1 instead of the usage-error status 2.
labels.root_cause: The mcp subcommand's bridge address validation returned a generic failure code.

labels.symptom: Automate to Sequence with short clips adds a dissolve that starts before the first clip.
labels.root_cause: The transition kept the requested overlap instead of the clamped per-cut overlap.

labels.symptom: Dragging with the Track Select tools does not move the selected clips.
labels.root_cause: A press with the tool only selected clips and never started a drag.

labels.symptom: 7.1 AAC audio reports seven or twelve channels and loses a channel or imports silent.
labels.root_cause: The channelConfiguration index was used directly as the channel count.

labels.symptom: MKV video with B-frames and no DefaultDuration reports half its frame rate.
labels.root_cause: The frame rate came from the median gap between blocks in decode order rather than presentation order.

labels.symptom: BT.2020 H.264/HEVC video is treated as Rec709 once decoded.
labels.root_cause: vui_color ignored the VUI colour primaries.

labels.symptom: Tests fail intermittently on Windows because of shared fixture races and CRLF line endings.
labels.root_cause: Concurrent test fixture writes and CRLF line endings in the packaging test helper on Windows.

labels.symptom: Some menu labels and messages show in English or with inconsistent wording when the UI is set to Japanese.
labels.root_cause: The Japanese translation catalog was missing entries and had no completeness test.

labels.symptom: The settings schema reports the Restore open sequences preference as having no effect, although it works.
labels.root_cause: The schema row for timeline.restoreOpenSequences was left as wired: false.

labels.symptom: Audio cannot be exported as MP3.
VP9 video decodes slowly because the loop filter runs on one thread.
labels.root_cause: Each frame's loop filter ran on a single thread in raster order.

labels.symptom: The app icon uses the old animal artwork instead of the letter monogram.
